title: Admin / Project Coordinator
description:
About Us

Presidential Building Services Pty Ltd is a Perth-based construction company specialising in residential, commercial, and insurance restoration projects across Western Australia. We are a fast-paced, client-focused business managing multiple projects simultaneously, and we are looking for a highly organised and proactive Admin / Project Coordinator to support our operations remotely.



About the Role

This is a full-time remote position supporting our Managing Director and operations team. You will play a key role in keeping our projects and office running smoothly — from coordinating schedules and documentation to liaising with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers.



We are looking for someone who can start immediately. Please only apply if you are serious, available now, and can demonstrate extensive, proven experience in every essential requirement listed below. If you cannot provide specific examples of your previous work and skills, please do not apply.



Key Responsibilities

Project Coordination



Assist with scheduling, tracking, and coordinating multiple construction projects

Maintain and update project files, timelines, and progress reports

Coordinate with site teams, subcontractors, and suppliers to ensure smooth project delivery

Prepare and manage variation requests, purchase orders, and job documentation

Support estimating tasks including data entry, quote preparation, and follow-ups

Update and manage jobs in AroFlo (our project management software)

Schedule and coordinate site visits for quoting purposes using GoHighLevel (GHL), including booking confirmations, reminders, and follow-ups

Administration & Operations



Manage inboxes, calendars, and correspondence on behalf of the Director

Prepare contracts, proposals, reports, and client communications

Handle accounts administration including invoicing, receipts, and expense tracking

Maintain organised digital filing systems and document control

Assist with compliance documentation, WHS records, and site registers

Liaise with clients, government departments, and insurance companies as required

Confidently make and receive phone calls on behalf of the business — you must be comfortable picking up the phone to follow up, resolve issues, and communicate directly with clients, suppliers, and subcontractors

What We're Looking For

Essential (do not apply if you cannot demonstrate extensive experience in all of the following):



Available to start immediately — no exceptions

Minimum 2 years' extensive, demonstrable experience working in an Australian service-based or construction company (remote or in-person)

Strong understanding of Australian construction industry processes, terminology, and documentation — you must be able to provide specific examples

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

A genuine problem-solver — someone who takes ownership of issues and finds solutions without needing to be prompted

Confident and proactive communicator, including making and receiving phone calls without hesitation

High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities

Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)

Reliable internet connection and a professional home office setup

Highly Regarded:



Experience using GoHighLevel (GHL) for scheduling, CRM, or pipeline management

Experience using AroFlo or similar construction/field management software

Familiarity with Australian invoicing, GST, and basic bookkeeping

Experience supporting a director or senior manager in a fast-paced environment

Background in insurance restoration or commercial fitout projects

Working Hours & Time Zone

This role operates 8:00am – 5:00pm AWST (Western Australian Standard Time), which aligns directly with Philippine Standard Time (PST) — no unsociable hours or time zone adjustments required.



What We Offer

Immediate start for the right candidate

Stable, long-term full-time role with a growing Australian construction company

Direct working relationship with the Managing Director

Opportunity to grow your skills across project management, estimating, and operations

Supportive team environment with clear processes and systems

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a brief cover letter to [Insert
 Address] with the subject line: Admin / Project Coordinator Application – [Your Name]



In your cover letter, you must include specific examples demonstrating:



Your previous experience working with Australian companies (construction or service-based) — include company names, your role, and what you did

Software tools you have used (especially AroFlo and/or GoHighLevel) — describe how you used them

A specific problem you solved in a previous role and how you resolved it

Confirmation that you are available to start immediately

Generic cover letters will not be considered. If you cannot provide specific examples, please do not apply.



Incomplete applications or those that do not address the above points will not be reviewed.

title: Cabinetry Estimator (Remote)
description:
Job Description: Joinery Estimator (Remote)

 

Location: Remote (Philippines) – Work from Home

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Hours: [e.g., 8:00am – 5:00pm AWST, Monday to Friday]

 

About Alba Craft

Alba Craft is a Perth-based custom cabinetry and joinery business servicing residential and commercial projects across Western Australia. We specialise in high-quality joinery and cabinetry solutions for builders, developers, and fitout contractors.

 

Position Overview

 

The Joinery Estimator is responsible for reviewing tender documentation and construction drawings to prepare detailed, itemised bills of quantities for joinery and cabinetry works. This is a critical role that enables the Managing Director to focus on pricing, quoting, and client submissions by ensuring all quantity takeoffs are accurately completed and ready for review.

 

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, operates with minimal direction, and proactively identifies issues before they become problems. This role suits a highly skilled, self-motivated professional who thrives working independently in a remote environment.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Review tender documentation, architectural drawings, and specifications in full

Identify and extract all joinery and cabinetry scope items from construction drawings

Prepare clear, itemised bills of quantities for joinery and cabinetry works

Organise takeoff data in a structured format ready for pricing by the Managing Director

Proactively flag drawing discrepancies, missing information, or scope ambiguities before they cause delays

Anticipate what information Ramadan or Jason will need and prepare it without being asked

Liaise directly with Ramadan or Jason to clarify scope and resolve queries

Manage your own workload and deadlines across multiple concurrent tenders without prompting

Maintain accurate records of all tender documentation, drawings, and quantity schedules

Continuously look for ways to improve the accuracy and efficiency of the takeoff process

 

Skills and Experience Required

 

Demonstrated experience in construction estimating, quantity surveying, or joinery/cabinetry takeoffs

Previous experience working for or with an Australian construction or joinery firm (preferred)

Proven ability to work independently and unsupervised, managing priorities and deadlines without daily direction

A proactive mindset — you identify problems early, ask the right questions, and take initiative

Ability to read and interpret architectural and construction drawings to Australian standards

Familiarity with Australian construction documentation, specifications, and tender formats

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; experience with estimating software (e.g., Buildxact, Cubit, or similar) is an advantage

Strong attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy

Excellent organisational and time management skills

Good written English communication skills

Reliable internet connection and dedicated home office setup

 

Working Conditions

 

Full-time remote position based in the Philippines

Required to work Australian Western Standard Time (AWST) hours: [e.g., 8:00am – 5:00pm, Monday to Friday]

Must be available for video calls and real-time communication during working hours

Mandatory use of Timelogger with live stream enabled during all working hours. This is a non-negotiable condition of engagement. Live stream monitoring is active throughout the working day to support accountability and transparency across the remote team

 

What We're Looking For

 

This role is not for someone who needs hand-holding or constant check-ins. We need a professional who:

Takes full ownership of their work from start to finish

Delivers accurate, well-organised takeoffs on time, every time

Speaks up early when something doesn't look right

Treats every tender as if their name is on the quote

 

If you are highly skilled, self-driven, and take pride in producing quality work without being asked twice, we want to hear from you

title: Football TikTok Video Editor — Daily 60-75s Story Videos)
description:
We run a growing football (soccer) TikTok brand and need a dedicated editor producing one 60-75 second story video per day in a fast-paced documentary style.



What you'll make: vertical football storytelling videos built from short match clips, player photos on a grid background, stock footage and meme reaction inserts, cut to a pre-recorded voiceover. Reference standard (study this before applying): 
 — your work must match this pacing, caption style and photo treatment.



Scope per video:

1. Source visuals for every narrative beat — short match clips cropped to 9:16, player headshots placed on our grid-background template, and reaction clips on the shock moments — building our shared asset library as you go.

2. Rough-cut against the voiceover at 25-30 hard cuts per minute, no fancy transitions, every fact synced to a matching visual.

3. Caption pass: bold all-caps white text with black outline, player names and transfer fees highlighted in yellow, timed phrase-by-phrase to the voiceover. This is where we judge quality.

4. Consistent colour grade across mixed footage, voiceover-forward audio mix, export 9:16 1080p.



We supply the script, voiceover, beat markers, and a full written SOP.



Requirements: Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, strong football knowledge (you must recognise players and find the right clips fast), proven short-form portfolio (2-3 links), one video per working day after the first two weeks, reliable internet.



Paid test task: we send one script + voiceover; you deliver a finished video within 48 hours. Paid regardless of outcome.



Application filter: Watch the reference video before applying. Start your application with the word SCOUT, then tell us in one sentence which club the video says signed Lewandowski for €4.5 million. Applications missing either will not be read.

title: Personal Brand Video Editor — Daily Short Clips + Weekly YouTube Videos from Recorded Sessions
description:
We run a personal brand and need a dedicated editor turning long-form recorded sessions into daily short clips AND weekly YouTube videos.



Short clips (2-3/day): 20-150 second 9:16 clips in a raw, caption-driven style. Reference standard (study before applying): 
 — natural speech kept intact, visible jump cuts, subtle punch-ins on emphasis, word-synced bold captions with keyword highlights, opens instantly on the hook line, ends the moment the point lands.



YouTube videos (2-3/week): 8-20 minute 16:9 edits from the same sessions — one topic per video or several related questions stitched into a themed episode. Same raw style: jump cuts on dead air, occasional punch-ins, on-screen text for key numbers only, simple chapter cards between questions, timestamps in description. Flag 2-3 freeze-frames per video for thumbnails.



Workflow: edit the YouTube video first, then pull the short clips from the same timeline.



Scope:

1. Select the strongest moments — clips open on a question or bold claim and end on a quotable line; episodes open on the best question, no intro.

2. Reframe, jump-cut dead air, punch-ins on emphasis. Do NOT over-edit — the raw feel is the style.

3. Word-synced captions on shorts (bold sans-serif, white with black outline, key words highlighted); light key-phrase text only on longform.

4. Deliver with suggested post captions (shorts) and title options + timestamps (YouTube).



We supply recordings with transcripts and a written style guide.



Requirements: Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (CapCut alone not enough for the longform work); portfolio with BOTH short-form and long-form examples (2-3 links each); sustained output of 2-3 clips/day plus 2-3 videos/week after the first two weeks; reliable internet.



Paid test task: one 20-minute recording; deliver your 2 best short clips AND a rough 5-minute longform cut within 72 hours. We judge selection as much as editing. Paid regardless of outcome.



Application filter: Watch the reference clip before applying. Start your application with the word PAYOUT, then tell us in one sentence what account size the speaker says he'd rebuild from. Applications missing either will not be read.

We're at the very start of building a proper team, and you'd be one of the first people in it.

We'll work mainly off of

In terms of working with me, I'm someone who is reasonably relaxed and not micro-manage-y, but very detail-oriented. Well I guess I can be micro-manage-y, but that only happens if I don't trust you and trust is the hallmark of any good collaboration. I am absolutely a perfectionist though. You would be a good fit for this is you already write fiction novels, like reading about your MBTI, playing interactive fiction games, are a part of fandoms, like fanfiction or manga or anime. If you're a good problem solver, detail oriented, and a perfectionist yourself, then you should apply and let me know why you're a good fit.



FOR NEXT STEPS:

 and also this one 
 



This should take you less than 10 minutes in total. It will give you a better sense of what each story is and how it plays out.

title: Lead List Building & Automation Specialist
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We run cold
 and LinkedIn outbound campaigns for a growing group of clients. We are hiring a careful, resourceful operator to keep those campaigns supplied with qualified prospects before inventory becomes urgent.



This is a hands-on role combining list building, research, critical thinking, spreadsheets, and AI-assisted coding. List building is the main focus. You will also regularly use Codex or similar tools to fix bugs, improve our internal software, and make the workflow faster. This is not a full-time developer position, but coding and vibe-coding experience are valuable parts of the job. Experience in both list building and software work is strongly preferred.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Monitor campaign inventory and replenish lead lists before campaigns run low.

- Turn each client's ideal customer profile into accurate, creative search strategies.

- Build cold
 and LinkedIn lists using AI Ark, our internal List Builder, and approved supporting tools.

- Check company fit, decision-maker fit, exclusions, recent client history, required fields, and duplicate risk.

- Prepare verified cold
 data and precise LinkedIn profile lists.

- Review feedback, document completed work, maintain trackers, and communicate real blockers early.

- After training, use Codex or similar AI coding tools to diagnose bugs, fix problems, and improve your assigned copy or branch of the List Builder.

- Test software changes carefully. Do not change the shared production version without approval.

- After training, communicate professionally in relevant client Slack channels.



TOOLS



AI Ark, our internal List Builder, 
 when assigned,
Bison, Codex, ChatGPT, GitHub, Slack, Google Drive, spreadsheets, and CSV files.



REQUIREMENTS



- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Reliable availability Monday-Friday for the full 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time coverage window. U.S. daylight-saving changes shift the corresponding Philippines hours.

- Practical experience in lead generation/list building, coding, automation, or AI-assisted/vibe coding.

- Experience in both list building and software work is strongly preferred.

- Strong critical thinking. You can interpret an unclear target audience, use sensible proxy signals, and explain your decisions instead of only copying instructions.

- Excellent attention to detail with filters, spreadsheets, CSV files, research, and duplicate checks.

- Honest about errors and never fabricates data.

- Reliable computer, internet connection, and power/internet backup for an overnight Philippines schedule.



PREFERRED



Hands-on experience using Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to build or improve real software is especially valuable. B2B outbound, Apollo, GitHub, Python, JavaScript, API, automation, or multi-client list-building experience is also helpful.



HOW TO APPLY



Send a short, specific application. Honest answers are more useful than generic AI-written responses.



Please include both of the following with your application:

- Your resume.

- A video of yourself answering all six questions below. Please answer the questions in order in one video.



1. Briefly describe your lead generation/list-building experience and your coding or AI-assisted/vibe-coding experience. Give one specific example. If you are much stronger in one area, say so.

2. Describe one lead-list or automation project you completed and what you personally did.

3. If several client campaigns are low on leads, how would you d
 what to work on first?

4. Describe a time you used proxy signals because a tool did not offer the exact filter you needed.

5. Confirm that the schedule and $500 monthly compensation work for you.

6. Describe your computer, internet, and power-backup plan. Include your earliest start date, OnlineJobs.ph profile, and a relevant work sample if available.



HIRING PROCESS



Application review, short interview, and a 30-45 minute Apollo search-strategy assignment for selected candidates. Candidates do not receive client data or production access during hiring.

What you will do



Answer customer
s and messages (order status, shipping, product questions, ingredient and safety questions, usage questions)

Manage subscriptions in Loop: pause, skip, reschedule, swap, cancel, reactivate, fix failed payments

Handle money-back guarantee cases cleanly and fairly

Save subscriptions through genuine problem-solving and sensible retention offers, not pressure

Process refunds, replacements and reshipments in Shopify

Track recurring issues and report them weekly (what customers keep asking, what keeps breaking)

Help build and maintain our macro/canned response library and SOPs

Fluent, natural written English. Not "good enough" English. Our customers are American consumers and your replies must read like they were written by a native speaker. This is non-negotiable and we will test it.

Proven customer support experience with ecommerce brands. Please tell us which brands, which niche, and what your ticket volume was.

Experience with Shopify (orders, refunds, fulfillment) is required

What we offer



Well above the usual rate for this role. We pay for quality and we know what quality costs.

A long-term position. We are not looking for someone for three months. We are looking for the person who still runs our support in two years, with more responsibility and more pay.

We pay very well, and we expect very high performance. That means: fast first-response times, no tickets left sitting, no copy-paste answers that ignore what the customer actually asked, and ownership of the outcome. If you need to be chased for updates, this role is not for you. If you like owning something and being paid properly for it, you will do well here.

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
About Us



We help wedding filmmakers create better wedding films and grow the business side of their business. We’re a lean, 7‑figure online coaching company. You’ll work directly with our ads content team.





Role Overview

Your mission is to turn raw talking‑head content, screen recordings, and behind‑the‑scenes clips into short‑form, direct‑response ads for
, Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok that drive leads and sales.



You’ll take hooks, scripts, and raw footage, and deliver ad‑ready edits on time every week without needing to be chased.



This is not a cinematic / vlog editor role. It’s a performance ad editor role: fast hooks, clear promises, clean captions, simple b‑roll.







Responsibilities

- Edit short‑form vertical ads (15–60 seconds) for Reels, TikToks, Shorts, and in‑feed placements.



- Turn raw footage + hook ideas into 3–4 new ad concepts per week, plus 2–3 variants per concept (different hooks, captions, CTAs).



- Add captions, on‑screen text, simple transitions, b‑roll, and sound effects following our style guide.



- Cut multiple hook versions from the same base video to test different openings.



- Export in correct formats and aspect ratios, name files correctly, and organize them in our content folders.



- Do a clean quality check before submitting (spelling, audio, framing).



- Hit agreed weekly output and communicate early if anything will be late. Turn revisions around within 24 hours.







Requirements

Strong portfolio of short‑form ads or UGC‑style edits (not just travel vlogs / montages).



Excellent editing skills in Premiere Pro, CapCut, or similar.



Great eye for:

- Hooks and thumb‑stops in the first 3 seconds

- Pacing for 15–60s ads

- Clean, simple, modern style





Basic understanding of what makes an ad sell (clear promise, proof, CTA).



- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Reliable internet for downloading / uploading video.

- Able to handle at least 3–4 new concepts and 20–30 finished ads per week.

- Able to start ASAP.





Nice to Have (not required)

- Experience with: direct‑response ads, online courses/coaching, Meta/TikTok ad creatives, motion graphics, AI tools, thumbnail design, working inside a content/ad pipeline.





Do NOT apply if:

- You are an agency or plan to subcontract work to someone else.

- You can’t reliably commit to weekly output and deadlines.

- You dislike following a style guide, checklists, or a set process.

- You are looking for a one‑time gig (this is ongoing, long‑term work).





Compensation & Growth

- This is a full‑time, ongoing role.

- Starting: $600-$1,200 USD per month (depending on experience and location) for:

- 3–4 new ad concepts per week

- 12–16 finished ads per week

- First 90 days are a ramp period at the starting rate.

- After 90 days, if you’re consistently hitting volume + quality, we’ll review and can increase to $800-$1,200+/month and/or give more responsibility.

- Small performance bonuses possible for new winning creatives that beat our current best ads.





How to Apply (follow these steps exactly)

- Join the Skool group here: 
 

If you already joined, please turn on your notifications. Our team will reach out to you there if it’s a fit.





- Subject line: change your
 subject to:

“I want to edit ads for [Founder’s Name]”



- Portfolio: reply with:

3–5 links to short‑form ads or UGC‑style edits you’ve done (Reels/TikTok/Shorts). Do not share any long form videos. 



- Briefly state which tool you used (Premiere, CapCut, etc.).



- Applications that do not follow these steps will not be considered.



If considered:

- $10 paid test project (2–3 hours).

- If hired, 2‑week paid trial at the agreed monthly rate.

- If we’re both happy, this becomes a long‑term role with the 90‑day ramp and then a raise based on performance.

You will receive the products and instructions from our team. Your job is to turn them into clean, professional, and fully functional online stores that are ready for advertising.



You do not need to be an advanced programmer or graphic designer.

Your Main Responsibilities

Wix Store Creation

Build complete e-commerce stores using Wix

Create product pages and landing pages

Build simple sales funnels for individual products

Upload product images, videos, descriptions, prices, and variations

Organize menus, product categories, headers, and footers

Configure basic Wix e-commerce settings

Add important store pages such as contact, shipping, returns, and frequently asked questions

Follow our templates and store-building guidelines

Make sure every store looks professional and trustworthy

Product Page and Landing Page Creation

Create clear and attractive product pages

Present product benefits in an easy-to-understand way

Add product images, videos, icons, reviews, and frequently asked questions

Create strong headlines and calls to action

Organize page sections correctly

Make sure product information is accurate

Improve existing pages when required

Create new landing page variations for advertising campaigns

Store Testing

Check product prices and variations

Test the complete checkout process

Make sure stores work correctly on desktop and mobile devices

Check for spelling, layout, and formatting errors

Identify and report technical problems

Make sure every store is ready before advertising begins

Store Operations

Upload and update products

Keep existing stores organized

Process and fulfill customer orders

Add tracking information when available

Monitor order status

Report stock problems, supplier delays, and fulfillment issues

Update store information when necessary

Keep shared tracking sheets accurate

Track basic revenue, expenses, product costs, and profit

Coordinate with the Media Buyer before new campaigns are launched

Who We Are Looking For



You may be a good fit if you:



Have experience using Wix

Have built a Wix website, online store, or landing page before

Have good written English

Building Wix e-commerce stores

Creating product landing pages

Working with dropshipping stores

Processing and fulfilling online orders

title: DIGITAL PROJECT COORDINATOR
description:
Great campaigns need more than good ideas. They need someone who can keep the work moving when there are multiple clients, competing deadlines, missing inputs, and several people involved in every deliverable.



Leads Global is looking for a Digital Project Coordinator who wants to become the person a marketing team can rely on when work gets busy. You will work at the centre of client delivery, helping turn ideas into organised, on-time execution across copy, creative, paid media, landing pages, and campaign implementation.



This is a strong career opportunity for someone with hands-on social media or digital marketing experience who is ready to move into project coordination. You will not be expected to be a senior manager on day one. You will be given real responsibility, clear standards, and the opportunity to grow into a capable project-management professional.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



You will manage the daily flow of client work in Basecamp. You will make sure every task has a clear owner, due date, next action, and enough context for the assigned person to begin without guessing.



You will coordinate across copywriters, designers, media buyers, developers, and contractors. You will follow up before deadlines become a problem, identify what is missing, and help remove obstacles so the team can deliver quality work on time.



When an issue needs a decision, you will raise it early and clearly. When a client needs an update, you will help prepare communication that is calm, accurate, and useful. Your work will make it easier for everyone else to focus on doing excellent work.



WHO WILL THRIVE HERE



You have practical experience in social media, digital marketing, content coordination, paid media support, or a creative/digital agency. You understand the basics of how marketing campaigns are built and why small details can make the difference between a smooth launch and a stressful one.



You are the person who notices when something does not add up. You keep track of details, follow through on what you say you will do, and prefer to solve a problem while it is still small. You can manage several moving parts without losing the larger picture.



You communicate clearly in written English. You are comfortable asking precise questions, following up professionally, and giving others the information they need to do their best work. You are open to feedback, eager to learn, and serious about building a long-term career in digital project coordination.



Experience with Basecamp is a plus. Experience with ClickUp, Asana, Monday, Trello, Notion, or similar tools is also useful. Familiarity with Meta Ads, Google Ads, social media content, campaign assets, landing pages, or funnel work will be an advantage.



We use AI tools to improve speed and quality across the business. We value people who can use AI intelligently while maintaining good judgement, checking details, and taking responsibility for the final outcome.



WHY LEADS GLOBAL



You will be part of a team that cares about doing thoughtful work well. We value integrity, clear communication, continuous improvement, and measurable marketing results. You will receive practical exposure to real client delivery and a clear pathway to grow your project-management capability as you prove yourself.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this form: 



Qualified applicants will receive a practical assessment. It is designed to show how you approach project coordination, competing deadlines, incomplete information, and client communication.

title: ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR — U.S. BUSINESSES
description:
ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR — U.S. BUSINESSES



Full-Time | 9 AM–5 PM Eastern Time | $8–$10/hour + $30–$50 Per Qualified Meeting Held



This is not an entry-level cold-calling job.



We're a U.S.-based IT asset disposition, e-waste recycling, and data destruction company looking for one genuinely excellent B2B lead generator to join our Philippine-based team.



If you're confident on the phone, communicate exceptionally well with U.S. professionals, think on your feet, and consistently turn cold prospects into real opportunities, we want to hear from you.



We're not looking for someone who simply makes 100 calls and reads a script.



We want someone who builds pipeline — including with prospects who may not need us today but will six months from now.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



Call U.S. businesses and speak with IT managers, office managers, facilities managers, owners, and other decision-makers.



You'll identify IT recycling, data destruction, and equipment disposition opportunities; qualify and book meetings for our sales team; follow up by phone and
; re-engage older leads; and maintain accurate CRM notes and next steps.



WHAT WE NEED



-2+ years of successful B2B cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

-Substantial experience calling U.S. businesses

-Exceptionally clear, natural spoken English — U.S. prospects should understand you easily and without effort

-Strong objection-handling and conversational skills

-Persistence without being pushy

-Strong organization and follow-up habits

-Ability to work independently and take ownership of results



IT services, MSP, SaaS, telecom, technology, or recycling experience is a plus.



Zoho and Dialpad experience are helpful but not required. We'll teach the software to the right salesperson.



COMPENSATION



$8–$10/hour base, based on experience



PLUS a tiered monthly bonus for every qualified meeting that is actually held:



-1–9 meetings: $30 each

-10–14 meetings: $40 each

-15+ meetings: $50 each



Crossing a tier raises ALL qualified meetings held that month to the higher rate.



Examples:



-9 meetings = $270

-10 meetings = $400

-15 meetings = $750



There is no cap.



Strong performers can realistically earn $1,800–$2,400+ per month.



A qualified meeting means you reached the right business contact, identified a legitimate current or foreseeable need, and the prospect genuinely agreed to meet with our sales team.



You do not need to establish budget or timeline — that's our sales team's job.



No bonus for calendar stuffing, unqualified meetings, or no-shows.



Once a meeting is legitimately qualified and held, it's paid.



FORMER EMPLOYER REFERENCE — NON-NEGOTIABLE



Before any offer is made, we must personally speak with at least one former supervisor, manager, or business owner who directly managed your B2B calling or appointment-setting work.



A coworker, personal reference, or HR-only employment verification will not substitute.



We will only contact the reference once you are a finalist.



If you cannot provide this reference, please do not apply.



HOW TO APPLY



Use exactly 12 Apply Points. Applications that do not follow this instruction will not be reviewed.



Please answer:



-How many years of B2B calling experience do you have, including experience calling U.S. businesses?

-What industries have you called?

-In your most recent role, approximately how many qualified meetings did you book each month, and how many actually held?

-What CRM and calling platforms have you used?

-What hourly rate are you seeking?



REQUIRED: 60–90 SECOND RECORDING



Include a Loom, Vocaroo, or similar voice/video recording created specifically for this application. No generic introduction you've sent to multiple employers.



Please speak naturally rather than reading a prepared answer.



Tell us:



-Your name

-Your recent B2B calling experience

-One specific cold call from the last few months that didn't go as expected and what you did



Do not perform a scripted sales pitch.



If we interview you, you'll be given live cold-call situations and objections you have not seen in advance.



Subject: ELITE B2B LEAD GENERATOR – [Your Name]



We're hiring one person.



If you're genuinely excellent at generating B2B opportunities and want your compensation tied directly to performance, we want to hear from you.

title: Creative Strategist for Scaling DTC Brand
description:
READ THIS FIRST: To apply, start your message with the word ANGLE. Applications without it get deleted unread. We do this to find people who actually pay attention to detail.



## About Us



We run a portfolio of direct-to-consumer e-commerce brands (beauty). We move fast, test constantly, and live and die by our ad creative. We're not a corporate agency. You'll work directly with the founder, get quick feedback, and see your concepts go live in real campaigns within days.



## The Role



You'll own the front of the funnel: research → angles → hooks → briefs → iteration. You d
 what we make and why, not just how it's cut. This is performance strategy, not "brand vibes." You're measured on ROAS and CPA, not on how clever a concept sounds in a meeting. You'll turn customer research and competitor teardowns into a steady pipeline of testable ad concepts that actually scale.



## What You'll Do



- Research markets, customers, reviews, and competitors to find the angle

- Write hooks, scripts, and shot-by-shot briefs for editors and UGC creators

- Own the creative testing roadmap — what we test next, and why

- Read the data (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and d
 what to double down on or kill

- Turn winners into fresh angles, formats, and variations for testing (not lazy re-cuts)

- Direct editors and creators, and QC that the output matches the concept

- Keep a swipe and insight library so we're never starting from zero



## Must-Haves (track record required)



- 2+ years as a creative strategist for DTC/e-commerce (health/wellness or beauty strongly preferred) with Trackrecord

- You can point to specific winning ads/angles YOU conceived — and the numbers they hit

- Deep direct-response instincts: awareness levels, angles, mechanisms, hooks, offers

- You understand the full funnel — ad → advertorial/VSL/landing page → conversion

- Comfortable reading an ad account and forming a POV, not waiting to be told

- Strong written English — briefs a creator or editor can execute without 10 follow-ups

- High volume and fast iteration don't scare you



## Nice-to-Have



- Hands-on with AI creative tools (Higgsfield, Runway, ElevenLabs, Topaz, etc.)

- Can rough-cut or storyboard your own concepts

- Worked directly with media buyers on scaling accounts

- Familiar with advertorial and VSL structures



## Hours & Growth



Start at 20 hrs/week. If your angles win and you're reliable, this grows into more hours, a higher rate, and more ownership. We keep good people long-term.



## How to Apply (follow exactly — this is the test)



1. Start your message with ANGLE

2. Link a portfolio or case docs of ads/angles you concepted — concepts + results, not pretty edits you didn't strategize

3. In 3–4 sentences: pick your best-performing angle, the research/insight behind it, why the hook worked, and the result (ROAS / CPA / spend scaled — real numbers)

4. Tell us your process for finding a brand-new angle from scratch

5. List the tools you use (research, briefing, AI, analytics)

6. Confirm your weekly availability and timezone

7. how long youre in Creative Strategy already and track record



Applications that skip any step, hide the numbers, or lead with a generic "I'm hardworking and passionate" intro will not be reviewed.

title: Roblox Dev Assistant — Part-Time, AI-Assisted Game Development
description:
Job Title: Roblox Dev Assistant — Part-Time, AI-Assisted Game Development



We're looking for a part-time assistant to help build Roblox games using an AI-assisted development workflow. We have some existing reusable systems (economy, gacha mechanics, UI, monetization, and more) from an earlier project that can be reused or adapted, but there's real room to build new systems, improve on what exists, and even help shape new game ideas, this isn't a rigid, locked-in process.



This is a trial role to start, since finding the right fit for this AI-assisted workflow matters more than years of generic Roblox experience. We'll begin with a small paid test task before any ongoing commitment.



What you'll do day to day:

- Work alongside Claude Code (an AI coding assistant) to implement game features, building on existing systems where useful, or creating new ones as needed

- Handle the parts of development that require a human specifically: placing objects in 3D space, visually verifying UI and gameplay, playtesting, and screenshotting bugs for AI to fix

- Follow our workflow for syncing code between your editor and Roblox Studio (using a tool called Rojo)

- Contribute ideas on game mechanics, features, and direction, this is a genuinely collaborative role, not just execution

- Communicate clearly about progress and any blockers



What we're looking for:

- Some familiarity with Roblox Studio and Luau (the scripting language), even from personal projects

- Comfort using AI coding tools, or genuine willingness to learn quickly

- Good written and spoken English

- Reliable, stable internet connection

- A portfolio or sample of any past Roblox work, even unpublished personal projects, is a real plus

- Reliable communication and follow-through on a small paid test task before we discuss anything ongoing



Pay: $150/month, part-time, trial basis to start. First step is a small paid test task, ongoing scope and pay can grow from there if it's a good fit.

At OpenPath Finance, we help business owners, Bitcoiners, and freedom-minded entrepreneurs take control of their finances, reduce their tax burden, and build lasting wealth.



We're not here just to file returns. We work closely with clients year-round to strategically plan their tax and financial operations and ensure those plans are reflected in their books and filings. We care about the details because they drive real results.



We're a small, focused team that values thoughtful action, steady progress, and full ownership of our work. We're not looking for perfection, but we do look for people who take initiative, ask smart questions, and follow through.



If you're someone who pursues purpose, embraces growth, and wants to contribute to meaningful work with real impact, you'll feel right at home here. Learn more at 
.



================================================

ROLE OVERVIEW

================================================



We're hiring a Tax Preparer to join our team during tax season. You'll be assigned a mix of personal and business returns to prepare, and you'll also serve as the first-level reviewer on your teammate's work before anything reaches the firm owner and tax advisor.



The goal is simple: by the time a return reaches the tax advisor for final sign-off, it has been prepared carefully and reviewed thoroughly. His role is a quick final check, not a detailed review. That standard is on you and your teammate to uphold together.



This is a technical, detail-oriented role with real accountability. You'll work independently, manage your own queue, and communicate clearly when something needs escalation.



================================================

RESPONSIBILITIES

================================================



- Prepare assigned U.S. tax returns accurately and on time, including complex 1040s, 1065s, and 1120-S returns

- Perform first-level peer review on teammate's prepared returns before submission to firm owner

- Document review notes clearly so the final reviewer can move quickly and confidently

- Meet turnaround standard: returns must be finalized within two weeks of receiving a completed organizer

- Communicate proactively when client information is missing, unclear, or when a return requires escalation

- Follow firm workflows in TaxDome and prepare returns in Drake



================================================

REQUIREMENTS

================================================



- 5+ years of hands-on U.S. tax preparation and review experience

- Strong technical knowledge of complex Forms 1040, 1065, and 1120-S, 1120

- Experience working remotely for a U.S.-based CPA firm or tax practice

- Proficient in Drake Tax software

- Communicates clearly and professionally in written English -- client-facing communication is a core part of this role, including status updates, document requests, and follow-up questions

- Works independently, meets deadlines, and follows through without being chased

- Available during U.S. business hours, with morning Central Time availability required for weekly team meetings and working sessions with their team pod



================================================

PREFERRED

================================================



- Experience reviewing others' tax work, not just preparing

- Familiarity with TaxDome or similar tax workflow platforms

- Knowledge of Bitcoin, Bitcoin mining, and related tax and accounting considerations



================================================

GROWTH PATH

================================================



This starts as a seasonal, part-time engagement. For the right person, there is a clear path to increased hours, year-round work, and a more senior role within the firm as we grow. We invest in people who take ownership and grow with us.



================================================

HOW TO APPLY

================================================



To apply, click the Apply button and include the following in your message:



1. A link to your resume (Google Docs or Dropbox)

2. A short note -- no more than 2 paragraphs -- on why this role interests you and what kind of tax work you've handled most

3. Answer this question in 3-5 sentences: Describe a time you caught a significant error in a tax return, whether your own or someone else's. What was it and how did you handle it?



We review written responses first. Strong communicators who demonstrate real tax experience will move to the next stage.

title: FULL TIME & TOP PAY --- Business Development & Outreach VA | Cold Calling + Marketing
description:
Business Development & Outreach VA | Cold Calling + Marketing

Full-Time | Remote | 5-9 USD Per Hour



PLEASE READ THE ENTIRE POST AND FOLLOW ALL APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS. INCOMPLETE APPLICATIONS WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.



We are a growing restoration and construction company in Arizona looking for a smart, outgoing, resourceful Virtual Assistant to help us generate new business and build relationships with potential customers and referral partners.

This is not a web design position, and we are not looking for someone whose primary strength is sitting behind a computer building websites or funnels.



You must have EXCELLENT spoken and written English. If you don’t, this is not going to be the right fit. Because of the nature of this position there is a video submission required and you will not be able to make it into the next round of interviews if your English is not sufficient. 



The main goal of this position is simple:



Help us create more conversations, build more relationships, generate more opportunities, and ultimately sell more jobs and bring in more customers.



We want someone who is comfortable picking up the phone, communicating with people, following up consistently, using different forms of outreach, and thinking creatively about new ways to generate business through your assignments..

You will have systems and processes to follow that have been tested but we always welcome critical thinking and suggestions if you find a better approach to something.



We want someone who can think.

Someone who asks:

How can we get more people to respond?

What could we say differently?

How can we improve this campaign?

What follow-up are we missing?

Can AI or technology help us do this better?

What other opportunities should we be pursuing?

If you enjoy talking to people, solving problems, using technology, testing ideas, and figuring out ways to generate opportunities, this could be a great position for you.



What You'll Be Doing

A large part of your role will involve outbound lead generation and relationship building.



You Will Be:

Making outbound cold calls

Follow up with leads by phone, text,
, and social media

Contact potential customers

Contact homeowners who may have recently experienced property damage

Reach out to potential referral partners

Help schedule appointments and meetings

Research businesses and potential prospects

Build prospect lists

Manage ongoing follow-up

 marketing through Go High Level (GHL)

Help run LinkedIn outreach campaigns

Engage and communicate with people on LinkedIn

Keep leads and conversations organized in our CRM

Help develop new outreach campaigns

Track results and identify what's working

Suggest ways to improve response and conversion rates



You MUST be comfortable picking up the phone and talking to strangers.

You don't need to be an aggressive salesperson. In fact, we would rather have someone who is personable, curious, confident, and good at having natural conversations.



But if cold calling makes you uncomfortable, this position is probably not for you.

We Want Someone Who Can Think Creatively

We want someone who pays attention.



For example:

If people aren't answering, what else could we try?

If a certain message gets more responses, how can we use that?

If you find a better way to research prospects, follow up, automate repetitive work, or organize leads, bring us the idea.

You will be encouraged to test ideas, make suggestions, and help us improve.



Excellent English Is Extremely Important

You will represent our company when communicating with potential customers and business partners.

You need to speak English clearly, naturally, confidently, and professionally.

You should be comfortable having an unscripted conversation with an American customer or business owner.

SMS

LinkedIn

Social media

CRM follow-up

Other outreach channels



AI & Technology

Experience with tools such as these is valuable:

ChatGPT

Claude

Gemini

GoHighLevel

LinkedIn

Canva

Dialpad

CRM platforms

 marketing platforms

Automation tools

We would rather hire someone who is smart, resourceful, great with people, technologically capable, and eager to learn than someone who knows every feature inside GoHighLevel but doesn't enjoy outreach or generating business.



Marketing & Outreach

You will also help with:

Social media content

 outreach

SMS campaigns

Lead nurture campaigns

Referral partner outreach

Prospect research

Canva graphics and flyers

Basic marketing materials

AI-assisted content creation



We don't expect you to be an expert at everything.

We care much more about finding someone with the right combination of communication skills, intelligence, creativity, resourcefulness, and drive.



Who We're Looking For

Our ideal candidate is:

An excellent English speaker

Comfortable cold calling

Confident talking to strangers

Personable and professional

Smart and resourceful

Creative

Tech-savvy

Familiar with AI

Organized

Dependable

Curious

 outreach

GoHighLevel

Remote

Long-term position

VA BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT

title: Hiring Senior ECommerce Video Editor ( Extra Performance Bonuses!!)

We are a DTC eCommerce brand. We run paid social at a serious scale, and our creative is what separates us from everyone else in our space.



We are looking for a creative operator who understands *why* ads work, cares about performance, and takes real pride in the quality of their craft.



If you are the kind of editor who obsesses over the first three seconds, rewatches your own work to find what is not landing, this position is for you.



What This Role Looks Like



This is a **full-time, long-term position**. We do not hire editors to cycle through. We hire people we want to grow with, and we protect our best people.



**Hours:** 8 hours per day, Monday through Friday

**Output expectation:**

- 1 video per day if the project is a long-form VSL (up to 5 minutes)

- 3 videos per day for short-form ads



You will produce
 ad creative across multiple formats. You will have a clear brief, organized assets, and a team behind you. What we need from you is execution at the highest level.



What You Will Create



- Direct-response video ads built to drive purchases

- UGC-style ads that feel authentic, not produced

- AI spokesperson and presenter videos that look and sound human

- AI-generated B-roll that supports the script without looking artificial

- Motion-graphics ads with clean visual hierarchy

- Hook variations and creative iterations

- Testimonial, review-style, and listicle ads

- Product demonstrations and comparison ads

Direct-Response Editing

You understand what makes someone stop scrolling and what makes them buy. You can turn a script and a brief into a complete, conversion-focused ad. You know how to build a hook, carry tension through the video, and close with a call to action that actually converts.



UGC Editing

You can take raw creator footage and make it feel effortless. You know when to cut, when to leave imperfections in, and how to improve weak delivery without making the creator sound edited.



AI Video Production

You can use AI tools to generate or enhance spokesperson footage, voice-overs, and B-roll. You know how to catch the glitches, correct unnatural pacing, and produce an end result that does not feel artificial.



Motion Graphics and Sound Design

You can animate text, benefits, reviews, and offers in ways that aid clarity. You understand audio balancing, music selection, and how sound design affects retention.



Organization and Communication

You manage your own workload. You know what is due and when. You communicate blockers before they become problems. You submit clean, organized project files every time.



  Required Experience



- Professional video editing experience (senior level)

- Direct experience creating
 ad creative for 
 
 brands

- Experience producing or enhancing AI video content

- Strong motion-graphics skills (not just templates)

  - Adobe Premiere Pro

  - DaVinci Resolve

Kling, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Gemini, ChatGPT, Google Drive, Slack, Meta Ad Library

Our top editors earn **$5,000–$7,000 per month** when base and performance bonuses are combined. That ceiling is real. We have editors hitting it.

title: Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper | Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines
description:
Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper

Remote Independent Contractor – Philippines





Location: Philippines – 100% Remote

Engagement Type: Long-term Independent Contractor

Service Days: Monday to Friday

Reports To: Australian Client Manager

Client Contact: No direct client communication required



About the Role



We are an Australian accounting practice seeking an experienced Senior Australian Public Practice Bookkeeper based in the Philippines to support a portfolio of Australian clients.

This is a hands-on, non-client-facing role. You will work directly with an Australian Client Manager, who will manage all external client communication and provide instructions, priorities and review feedback.



You will be responsible for delivering accurate bookkeeping, payroll, BAS/IAS preparation, reconciliations, month-end work and accounting support across multiple Australian entities.

This opportunity is suitable only for candidates with substantial recent experience working within, or directly supporting, an Australian accounting firm, bookkeeping practice or public practice environment.



Key ResponsibilitiesBookkeeping and Reconciliations

· Manage end-to-end bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Complete bank, credit card, loan and merchant facility reconciliations.

· Reconcile payment platforms such as Stripe, Square, PayPal, Shopify and Wise.

· Process accounts payable and accounts receivable.

· Process supplier bills, sales invoices, credit notes, refunds and payments.

· Review aged receivables and aged payables.

· Process journals, accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.

· Reconcile director, shareholder, beneficiary and intercompany loan accounts.

· Maintain fixed asset registers and assist with depreciation schedules.

· Investigate unreconciled, duplicated, missing or incorrectly recorded transactions.



Account Code and GST Code Review



This is a senior-level role. You must be able to review the quality and technical accuracy of bookkeeping work.



You will be required to:



· Review and correct account codes.

· Review and correct GST tax codes.

· Identify incorrect use of GST on Income, GST on Expenses, GST-Free, Input Taxed and BAS Excluded codes.

· Review the GST treatment of overseas transactions, exports, reimbursements, disbursements, insurance payments and government grants.

· Identify personal, capital, private and non-deductible transactions.

· Review general ledger accounts for unusual balances and incorrect classifications.

· Review suspense, clearing and uncategorised transaction accounts.

· Self-review all work before submitting it to the Client Manager.

· Review work prepared by junior bookkeepers where required.



Australian Payroll



· Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payroll.

· Set up and maintain employee payroll records.

· Process ordinary hours, overtime, allowances, bonuses, deductions and reimbursements.

· Process annual leave, personal leave and termination payments.

· Prepare Single Touch Payroll reporting and year-end STP finalisation.

· Calculate and reconcile PAYG withholding.

· Calculate and reconcile employer superannuation.

· Review superannuation clearing house payments and identify rejected or unpaid amounts.

· Reconcile payroll reports, payroll journals and payroll liability accounts.

· Assist with payroll tax, workers compensation and other payroll compliance requirements.



BAS, IAS and Compliance Support



· Prepare BAS and IAS workpapers for internal review.

· Reconcile GST, PAYG withholding and PAYG instalment accounts.

· Review GST reporting under both cash and accrual methods.

· Reconcile BAS figures to the general ledger.

· Identify prior-period errors and transactions requiring GST adjustments.

· Assist with PAYG instalment variation calculations.

· Assist with Taxable Payments Annual Reports.

· Prepare supporting documents and schedules for the firm’s accountants and tax agents.

· Monitor internal deadlines and escalate missing information promptly.



Month-End and Year-End



· Complete monthly, quarterly and annual bookkeeping files.

· Reconcile all material balance sheet accounts.

· Review payroll, GST, superannuation and PAYG liabilities.

· Prepare accruals, prepayments and other adjusting journals.

· Review accounts payable and accounts receivable cut-off.

· Reconcile fixed assets, inventory and cost of goods sold where applicable.

· Prepare year-end workpapers and supporting schedules.

· Ensure client files are ready for financial statement and income tax return preparation.



Financial Reporting



· Prepare Profit and Loss Statements and Balance Sheets.

· Prepare cash flow and management reports where required.

· Compare results with prior periods, budgets or forecasts.

· Identify unusual movements, negative balances and potential accounting errors.

· Provide clear internal explanations and supporting schedules to the Client Manager.



Tax Return Experience – Highly Regarded, but not essential



Experience preparing Australian income tax returns or tax workpapers is not essential but will be a strong advantage.



Relevant experience may include:

· Individual and sole trader tax returns.

· Company tax returns.

· Trust tax returns and distribution workpapers.

· Partnership tax returns.

· Rental property schedules.

· Depreciation and capital allowance schedules.

· Tax reconciliation workpapers.

· Xero Tax, MYOB Practice, HandiTax or BGL.



Essential Experience and Skills



Applicants must have:

· At least five years of recent Australian public practice bookkeeping experience.

· Experience managing bookkeeping for multiple Australian clients.

· Advanced practical experience using Xero.

· Strong practical experience using MYOB.

· Strong practical experience using QuickBooks Online.

· Experience preparing BAS and IAS workpapers.

· Strong knowledge of Australian GST and account coding.

· Demonstrated experience reviewing and correcting GST codes.

· Strong Australian payroll, STP and superannuation experience.

· Advanced reconciliation and problem-solving skills.

· Experience preparing month-end and year-end workpapers.

· Excellent written and spoken English.

· Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

· The ability to work independently and manage multiple deadlines.

· High standards of confidentiality, integrity and professional conduct.

· Ability to use AI tools



Experience limited to internal bookkeeping for one Australian business may not satisfy the public practice experience requirement.



Qualifications



The following qualifications are highly regarded:

· Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance or Commerce.

· Diploma or recognised qualification in Accounting or Bookkeeping.

· CPA, Chartered Accountant or equivalent studies.

· Xero Advisor Certification.

· MYOB or QuickBooks certification.



Software



You must be confident using:



· Xero

· MYOB

· QuickBooks Online



Independent Contractor Arrangement



This is an independent contractor opportunity and not an employee position.



The contractor will:



· Provide services remotely from the Philippines.

· Provide their own computer, secure workspace, internet and backup power arrangements.

· Be responsible for their own business registration, taxation, invoicing and insurance obligations.

· Issue a valid monthly contractor invoice.



The contractor will ordinarily provide services Monday to Friday and maintain regular overlap with Australian business hours.



The parties will agree on a daily core collaboration window for meetings, questions and internal communication. Outside that window, the contractor may arrange their own working schedule, provided all deadlines and service requirements are met.



Timesheets and Work Records



The contractor must complete a daily timesheet recording:



· Date.

· Client or entity.

· Task performed.

· Time spent.

· Work completed.

· Outstanding issues and next steps.



Timesheets are used for client costing, workflow management, capacity planning and supporting the contractor’s invoice. They are not intended to operate as employee attendance records.

Remote Work Requirements



Applicants must have:



· A reliable computer or laptop.

· Stable high-speed internet.

· Backup internet.

· A quiet and secure home office.

· A suitable headset for online meetings.

· The ability to use multi-factor authentication and secure password systems.

· A strong commitment to privacy, confidentiality and data security.



How to Apply



Please submit:

· Your current resume.

· A brief cover letter of your Australian public practice experience.

· Details of your Xero, MYOB and QuickBooks Online experience.

· Details of your BAS, IAS and Australian payroll experience.

· Details of any Australian tax returns you have prepared.

· Your expected monthly contractor fee in Philippine pesos.

· Your earliest available commencement date.

· Confirmation of your internet.

· Confirmation that you can issue invoices as an independent contractor.



Pay: Php60,000.00 - Php70,000.00 per month

title: Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller (List Builder)
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as Prop Stream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

Application – Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller
