title: Performance Creative Strategist & Editor — Meta Ads
description:
Performance Creative Strategist & Editor — Meta Ads



Full-Time | Remote | DTC E-Commerce



Maverix is a growing pickleball brand looking for a talented Performance Creative Strategist & Editor to own our Meta advertising creative pipeline.



We are not looking for just a video editor. We need someone who understands performance marketing, can analyze Meta ad data, identify what’s working, and use those insights to develop and execute new creative.



What You’ll Do



You will work with our founder and media buyer to:



* Analyze Meta Ads performance, including ROAS, CPA, CTR, CPM, CPC, hook rate, retention, spend, and other key metrics.

* Identify winning ads, hooks, messaging, and creative angles.

* Develop a weekly creative strategy based on performance data.

* Research competitors, Meta Ad Library, and current DTC creative trends.

* Create new concepts and variations of winning ads.

* Edit direct-response video ads using our existing footage, UGC, testimonials, product content, reviews, and founder content.

* Design high-quality static/image ads.

* Use AI tools where appropriate to increase creative output.

* Continuously test, learn, and improve our advertising creative.



Weekly Deliverables



We are looking for approximately:



* 10 video ads per week

* 10 static ads per week



This will include a combination of new concepts, new hooks, variations of winners, testimonials, product-focused ads, and other creative tests.



Our goal is not simply more content. We want ads that sell.



Who We’re Looking For



You should have:



* Experience creating Meta ads for DTC/e-commerce brands

* Strong direct-response video editing skills

* Strong static ad/graphic design skills

* Experience analyzing Meta advertising performance

* An understanding of hooks, creative testing, consumer psychology, and ad fatigue

* The ability to turn performance data into new creative ideas

* Strong English communication skills

* The ability to work independently without waiting for us to provide every idea

* Experience with AI creative tools is a plus



We want someone who can look at the data and say:



“This is what’s working, here’s why I think it’s working, and here’s what I think we should create next.”



How to Apply



Please send us:



1. Your resume

2. Your portfolio

3. Examples of Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads you personally created

4. Examples of both video and static advertising work

5. A brief description of your experience working with DTC/e-commerce brands

6. Your desired monthly compensation and availability



Please prioritize examples of direct-response advertising designed to generate sales, rather than organic social media content.



Start your application with SWING DIFFERENT so we know you read the entire posting.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team and help us build a world-class creative engine as Maverix continues to grow.

title: Business Operations Lead - Client Success, Bookkeeping & Systems
description:
We are a small US-based services company seeking a hands-on Business Operations Lead for 20 hours per week. This is a long-term player-coach role for someone who can own client follow-through, bookkeeping and billing operations, and the systems that keep the business organized.



The central outcome is simple: customers, money, records, and next actions should not fall through the cracks. You will reduce the founder's management load by maintaining an accurate operating picture, anticipating follow-ups, and surfacing exceptions early.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



CLIENT AND BUSINESS OPERATIONS

- Track inbound opportunities, active customers, partners, commitments, and next actions

- Follow up professionally with customers and partners until issues are resolved

- Maintain accurate CRM stages, customer status, billing status, and operating records

- Handle customer-service and payment issues or coordinate the right person to resolve them

- Produce a short weekly operating report showing priorities, exceptions, cash, receivables, and next actions



BOOKKEEPING, BILLING, AND CASH VISIBILITY

- Maintain day-to-day QuickBooks Online records and keep transaction data current

- Categorize transactions and reconcile bank, credit-card, Stripe, and internal records

- Run invoicing, track payments, review accounts-receivable aging, and follow up on overdue invoices

- Coordinate accounts payable, payroll, rent, subscriptions, and recurring payments

- Maintain a practical short-term cash view and flag discrepancies or upcoming risks

- Work with an outside accountant when deeper accounting or tax work is required



SYSTEMS AND PROCESS OWNERSHIP

- Become the first serious administrative and client-operations user of our custom internal system, Mnemo

- Identify missing fields, unclear ownership, broken handoffs, and automation opportunities

- Explain operational requirements clearly to the founder, who builds the software

- Test new CRM, billing, and reporting workflows through real use

- Document reliable procedures and, as the role grows, help supervise fractional Philippine support



THIS IS NOT

- A pure executive-assistant role

- A tax-accountant or fractional-CFO role

- A passive reporting position where you wait to be told what to check



YOU MAY BE A STRONG FIT IF YOU HAVE

- At least three years of remote experience spanning business operations, client operations, bookkeeping, billing, or founder support

- At least two years of hands-on QuickBooks Online work in a real business

- Direct experience with bank and credit-card reconciliation, AP/AR, invoicing, collections, and payment discrepancies

- Experience maintaining a CRM or another trusted system of record

- Strong written English and tactful customer follow-up

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- A history of closing loops, catching exceptions early, and making priorities easy for a busy founder to understand

- Experience leading people, reviewing work, or building procedures is strongly preferred

- Comfort learning and testing proprietary software



TERMS

- 20 hours per week initially, with the possibility of growing to 25 hours

- At least three working hours each weekday overlapping 8:00 AM–1:00 PM US Pacific time

- PHP 25,000 paid every two weeks

- 13th-month payment equal to one month's base compensation, prorated in the first year

- Paid work test followed by a long-term role

- Fully remote



TO APPLY



Begin your message with "CLOSE LOOPS" and answer these questions briefly and specifically:



1. Describe one recurring operational problem that nobody fully owned. How did you take ownership and prevent it from recurring?

2. Describe a real QuickBooks reconciliation discrepancy you investigated. What did you check and how did you resolve it?

3. How would you pursue an overdue invoice while preserving the customer relationship?

4. Which accounting, CRM, payment, and reporting systems have you used hands-on?

5. What exact Philippine hours can you work, and what jobs or clients do you currently have?



You may include one redacted example of a dashboard, SOP, reconciliation, or operating report. Do not share confidential employer or customer information. References will be requested later.

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



THIS IS A SALES ROLE. YOU NEED AT LEAST 6 MONTHS OF EXPERIENCE

PERSUADING PEOPLE AND MOVING THEM TOWARD A BOOKED APPOINTMENT

OR A SALE.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---



Full-Time | Long-Term | Remote | Pacific Time (Graveyard Shift in PH)

A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):



- Shift runs 10:45 PM – 7:45 AM PHT

- Same day-shift logic as above — shift starts the previous calendar evening in PH



This schedule is FIXED. It's based on data showing when our booking demand peaks. If you need flexible hours, rotating shifts, or plan to hold another job during these times, this role is not a fit.

Please re-read this section carefully and make sure BOTH the standard-time and daylight-savings schedules work for you long-term before applying. The 1-hour shift twice a year is non-negotiable — it follows US business hours. Please make sure BOTH schedules work for you long-term before applying.



---



COMPENSATION



Base pay:



$900–$1,000/month (depending on experience), paid via Wise on the 1st and 15th of every month.



13TH MONTH PAY included — paid every December on top of your regular base, not restructured into it. Prorated in your first year if you start mid-year. Total annualized base compensation including 13th month: $11,700–$13,000.



Performance bonuses (uncapped, paid monthly):



- $3 per new client showed appointment

- $2 per existing client showed appointment

- $1 per rebooking confirmation (low-effort confirmation calls for clients who already booked through the salon)



Tiered cumulative threshold bonuses (paid monthly):



- +$75 at 90 showed appointments/month

- +$150 at 120 showed appointments/month

- +$350 at 150 showed appointments/month



Worked examples:



Baseline performer — 90 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950 (midpoint)

- Performance: ~$225 (avg $2.50/show × 90)

- Threshold bonus: $75

- Total: ~$1,250/month



Solid performer — 120 showed appointments/month:

- Base: $950

- Performance: ~$300 (avg $2.50/show × 120)

- Threshold bonus: $225 ($75 + $150)

- Total: ~$1,475/month



Top performer — 150 showed appointments/month (90% show rate on ~167 booked):

- Base: $1,000

- Performance: $450 ($3×90 new + $2×20 existing + $1×40 rebooking)

- Threshold bonuses: $575 ($75 + $150 + $350)

- Total: ~$2,025/month



This is a PERFORMANCE-PAY ROLE. 30–50% of your monthly income should be earned through bonuses. The base is intentionally modest. If you want a high guaranteed salary with low expectations, this is not the role.



---



OTHER BENEFITS



1. Annual performance-based raise after your first year

2. 14 days of PTO per year, single bucket, available after 90-day probation (use for vacation, holidays, sickness — your call). For planned multi-day time off, give us at least 1 week's notice so we can plan coverage. Emergencies are understood — just communicate as soon as you can.

3. 90-day initial probation period. Pay is NOT REDUCED during probation.



To confirm you have read this post in full, include the word BURGUNDY in your answer to the final question on the application form



---



TARGET KPIs



- Lead to Booking Rate: 25%+

- Show Rate: 90%+

- Bookings per day: 4–9

- Showed appointments per month: 100–160

- Daily volume: Finish all assigned tasks each day. We supply ~17–25 leads per day plus follow-ups, no-shows, reactivations, and rebooking confirmations. HIGH CALL VOLUME (150–250 CALLS/DAY) IS NORMAL AND NON-NEGOTIABLE. If that sounds overwhelming instead of energizing, this is not a fit.



---



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Background:



- Female candidates tend to perform best with our 35–65 female clientele, so we especially encourage strong female applicants — but the role is open to all genders.

- Bilingual (English + Spanish) is a plus but not required.



Non-negotiable skills:



The five that matter most — these are what we screen hardest for:



- Real-time thinking. You generate a good response in seconds, not minutes. Under pressure, with no script in front of you. This is the single biggest predictor of success in this role.

- Inferential listening. You hear what someone means, not just what they said. A client says "I need to talk to my husband first" — she's usually not asking for permission, she's telling you something about price or certainty that she doesn't want to say directly. If you take everything at face value, you'll lose bookings.

- Conversational initiative. You never dead-end a conversation, and you don't give up on a lead that's still alive. A client says "that's kind of far for me" — a weak setter says "no problem, thanks anyway" and loses her. What she's actually telling you is that she doesn't believe the drive is worth it yet. That's not a rejection, it's an assumption you haven't disproven. Answering someone's question is only half a response; the other half is the move that keeps things going.

- Rapport building. You can get someone to open up and feel comfortable with you fast. This is the biggest factor in whether someone books. These are emotional decisions, not logical ones. You don't need American cultural references — you need to make people feel heard, understood, and safe.

- Diagnostic reframing. You can say someone's problem back to them more clearly than they said it. When you do that, people assume you have the solution. It's the fastest way to build trust that exists.



Everything else:



- ADVANCED ENGLISH WITH MINIMAL ACCENT. An American listener should not need to strain to understand you. If we have to focus to follow what you're saying, that's a disqualifier.

- STRONG SPOKEN COMMUNICATION — CLEAR, CONFIDENT VOICE. YOU DO NOT RAMBLE. YOU ARE NOT SOFT-SPOKEN. If you fill silence with words because dead air makes you nervous, this won't work.

- Typing speed: 40 wpm minimum (60+ strongly preferred). You'll be taking notes and sending texts while talking. You'll submit a typing test screenshot with your application.

- Process discipline. Every call gets dispositioned correctly. Every lead moves through the right cadence. Every opportunity gets marked accurately in the CRM. This isn't optional admin — it's how we measure everything. Great conversations with sloppy process still means we're flying blind.

- Script discipline for the structured parts of the call.

- Natural call control. You can guide a conversation efficiently without talking over clients or letting calls drift. You redirect politely and keep the call outcome-focused.

- Sales experience: 6 months minimum (1 year+ preferred). Job-hopping resumes (multiple roles under 3–6 months each) will be disqualified.

- Comfortable holding the line on policies (rescheduling, deposits, etc.) without weakening the script or over-promising.

- Objection handling — you acknowledge, ask questions to reframe, and guide the client. You don't fire off rebuttals that invoke more resistance.

- CRM literacy. GoHighLevel experience strongly preferred.

- High data accuracy. You enter info correctly the first time. This is a precision role, not a speed-only one.

- Strong working memory and multitasking — you can listen, think, type, recall rules, and follow scripts simultaneously without freezing.

- Emotional steadiness under high-volume periods. Spikes happen. You execute calm under load.



Preferred:



- Familiarity with the salon/beauty industry

- Personal interest in beauty or self-care

- Experience working with older female clientele (35–65)

- Experience with Slack, Slite, Airtable, Claude or ChatGPT (we use AI to streamline daily work — if you can leverage it, you'll move faster)



Mindset (MOST IMPORTANT):



We'd rather hire someone who's a 10 in mindset and 7 in sales skill than the reverse. Here's what we mean:



- Ownership & volume mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not tasks. You see high-volume, repetitive work as leverage, not burnout.

- Process discipline — you operate consistently inside defined systems. You let your personality show through tone and warmth, not by changing the words.

- Sales psychology — you understand how to influence through trust, value framing, and subtle urgency. You communicate with intention, not chit-chat.

- Speed bias — you move fast, close loops quickly, and accelerate under pressure instead of slowing down.

- Coachability — you receive feedback without ego and adapt immediately. No defensiveness, no excuses.

- KPI awareness — you understand the numbers behind your role and how your daily actions move them.



---



TECH REQUIREMENTS



Non-negotiable:



- Internet minimum requirements: 50 Mbps download, 10 Mbps upload, ping under 80ms. Stable connection. We will test your speed and audio live from your actual work setup before we hire.

- Backup plan for outages. If your internet or power cuts out mid-shift, you need a real fallback — mobile hotspot, secondary ISP, UPS, co-working space, or some combination. You'll describe your specific backup setup in your application.

- Computer: 8 GB RAM minimum (16+ preferred). Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent, 8th generation or newer. SSD preferred. Working laptop or desktop

- Mouse

- Wired headset with boom mic (3.5mm or USB-C). No Bluetooth, no laptop mic, no AirPods.

- Webcam — laptop built-in is fine. You'll be on camera for interviews, training, and coaching calls.

- Quiet, dedicated workspace. No roosters, no karaoke neighbors, no babies crying, no traffic, no dogs barking during calls. We will hear it on the call, and so will our clients.



Preferred:



- Second monitor

- You already own a headset that meets the requirements above (we'll provide one if you don't, but having your own helps you start faster)



---



DO NOT APPLY IF:



- You struggle to think quickly and respond in real time. If you need a moment to figure out what to say, this role will be painful. Clients don't wait.

- You need the client to lead the conversation. If you're comfortable answering questions but not steering, this isn't it.

- You can't hold a conversation without a script telling you what to say next.

- You type slowly. Under 40 wpm means you'll fall behind on notes and texts while you're talking.

- You have less than 6 months of experience persuading people, handling objections, and closing toward a booked appointment or sale.

- Your spoken English is hard to understand on the phone — this is a phone role first and the single biggest dealbreaker

- You're juggling multiple clients or planning to freelance on the side. THIS MUST BE YOUR ONLY JOB. We track performance closely and will discover this fast.

- You want a high guaranteed salary with low performance pressure

- You don't like high call volume or you find scripts "suffocating"

- You see remote work as "work whenever you feel like it"

- You can't sustain a graveyard shift long-term

- You're looking for a short-term gig — we expect a minimum 12-month commitment after probation



---



HIRING PROCESS



1. Application via Tally form (link below) — includes voice recording, Loom video, internet speed screenshot, backup plan description, and a few short written questions

2. 20-minute pre-screen call with our hiring partner

3. First-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — includes live roleplay

4. Second-round interview with Ethan (~45 min) — final fit + offer discussion

5. Offer — targeting hires between August 10 – August 20

6. Paid training begins immediately after offer acceptance



---



HOW TO APPLY



Submit your application through this Tally form: | 
 |



IMPORTANT: There is a confirmation requirement embedded in this post. Applications that miss it will be skipped regardless of experience.



The form will ask for:



- A screenshot of your typing test results (
)

- A screenshot of your internet speedtest (speedtest.net)

- A screenshot of your computer specs (RAM and processor)

- A description of your backup plan for power/internet outages

- A few short questions to gauge fit

- A short voice recording (Vocaroo or similar)

- A short Loom video introducing yourself



Applications submitted via direct messages on OnlineJobs.ph will NOT be reviewed. Use the Tally form.



---



Looking forward to meeting the right person.



Ethan

Founder, Midnight Siren



---

title: Organic Social Media & Growth Marketing Specialist
description:
TO APPLY: Please read and follow the application instructions at the bottom of this job ad. Applications that do not follow the requested format may not be considered.



EXPERIENCED CONTENT & GROWTH MARKETING SPECIALIST



We’re looking for an experienced marketer to help grow Sam Roberts Online Coaching, an Australian online coaching brand helping busy dads and men over 40 lose weight and improve their health.



This is not a basic social media scheduling role.



We want someone who can look at our audience, content and analytics, identify what is working, research what we should do next, and increasingly take ownership of our organic content pipeline.



The role will also initially include managing Instagram lead conversations, with the goal of moving suitable prospects towards booking appointments.



WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE CHEAPEST PERSON.



We’re prepared to pay well for someone genuinely good who can think independently, take ownership and become increasingly valuable to the business.



WHAT YOU’LL DO



* Research high-performing social content, creators, trends and formats

* Analyse our content and identify what is working, what isn’t and why

* Develop content ideas, hooks, scripts and filming briefs

* Repurpose our existing content and footage into new assets

* Coordinate with our video editor and graphic support

* Maintain the content calendar and production pipeline

* Schedule and publish content

* Review analytics and recommend what we should create next

* Initially spend part of your working day managing Instagram leads and helping move suitable prospects towards appointments



WHAT WE ALREADY HAVE



You will not be starting from zero.



We already have:



* An established brand, audience and clear target market

* A large library of existing content and footage

* Proven messaging and content themes

* A dedicated video editor

* Additional graphic/design support

* Established lead-generation and DM systems

* Internal AI, marketing and business resources



Sam and Matt handle filming and high-level strategy.



Your job is to help us get substantially more from the assets, knowledge and opportunities already available.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You should have strong experience in areas such as:



* Organic social media marketing

* Short-form content and Instagram

* Hooks, messaging and content strategy

* Analysing content performance

* Copywriting and content creation

* Researching trends, competitors and winning formats

* Using AI effectively without blindly relying on it



Most importantly, you should be able to think independently.



We don’t want someone waiting every morning to be told what to post.



Over time, we want you to be able to tell us:



“Here’s what performed, here’s why, and here’s what I think we should do next.”



Excellent written and spoken English is also important. You will communicate with our team and with Australian prospects through Instagram DMs.



Experience with fitness/coaching businesses, GoHighLevel, lead generation, appointment setting, Meta Ads, Canva or video editing is advantageous but not essential.



WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time, 40-paid-hour-per-week position.



Melbourne time:



* Sunday: 3:00pm–9:30pm



  * Includes 30-minute unpaid break

* Monday–Thursday: 12:30pm–10:00pm



  * Includes 1-hour unpaid meal break

* Friday + Saturday: Off



These hours are important because part of the role involves covering lead conversations during Australian afternoon/evening hours.



COMPENSATION



Compensation is open to discussion based on your experience and capability.



We would rather pay more for someone excellent who reduces our workload and helps grow the business than save money hiring someone who requires constant management.



FIRST 90 DAYS



There will be a 90-day onboarding/probation period.



Initially, content will receive closer review while you learn the brand, audience and systems.



As trust develops, we want to give you increasing ownership and independence.



You should also be comfortable using screen-recording or time-tracking software during the first 2–3 months while trust is being established.



HOW TO APPLY



Please
 your application to:







Subject:



Content & Growth Specialist Application – [YOUR NAME]



IMPORTANT: Please copy the questions below into your
 and answer EACH question separately.



1. WORKING HOURS



Can you commit long term to the following Melbourne working hours?



* Sunday: 3:00pm–9:30pm

* Monday–Thursday: 12:30pm–10:00pm

* Friday + Saturday: Off



2. SALARY EXPECTATION



What monthly salary would you expect for this role in PHP?



3. START DATE



What is your earliest available start date?



4. OTHER WORK COMMITMENTS



If hired, would you be willing to make this your only ongoing paid work commitment, meaning no other job, freelance clients or regular work for other businesses?



5. SCREEN RECORDING / TIME TRACKING



Would you be comfortable using screen-recording or time-tracking software during your first 2–3 months while trust is being established?



6. YOUR MARKETING SUPERPOWER



What is the ONE area of marketing you believe you are genuinely exceptional at?



Please choose one.



7. SHOW US ONE THING YOU’VE ACTUALLY DONE



Choose ONE social media account, campaign or piece of content you personally worked on.



In 100 words or fewer, tell us:



* What it was

* Exactly what YOU personally contributed

* What result it achieved, where measurable



8. INSTAGRAM DMs



Do you understand that this role will initially include spending part of your working day managing and responding to leads through Instagram DMs, with the goal of moving suitable prospects towards booking an appointment?



9. DM EXPERIENCE



What previous experience do you have managing:



* Social media DMs

* Lead conversations

* Appointment-setting conversations



A short answer is fine.



10. CV



Please attach your current CV.



11. PORTFOLIO



Please provide a link to your portfolio or the work examples most relevant to this role.



12. WHATSAPP



What is your WhatsApp number, including country code?



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a brief 10–15 minute WhatsApp video call.



The strongest candidates will then be invited to complete a paid practical marketing assessment using real content and data from our business.



AI and other tools will be allowed during the paid practical because we want to see how you would actually work in the role.

title: Account Manager - Client Communication, Lead Follow-Up & CRM

ACCOUNT MANAGER - CLIENT COMMUNICATION, LEAD FOLLOW-UP AND CRM



We are a fast-growing lawn care and landscaping company in Minnesota, USA. Our crews are in the field all day, which means the phone, the inbox and the CRM cannot take care of themselves. That is your job.



This is not a cold-calling boiler room. Most of your day is warm: existing customers who want another service, homeowners who just requested a quote, and leads who went quiet and need one more nudge. You are the voice of the company between the office and the customer.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- Own communication with our existing client base: service confirmations, schedule changes, post-job follow-ups, and upsells on additional services

- Work new leads fast. Call, text or
 every inbound inquiry, qualify it, and get it booked on the estimate calendar

- Run structured follow-up sequences on quotes that have not closed yet. This is where most of the revenue hides

- Build and clean prospect lists for outbound campaigns in our target service areas

- Send seasonal offers and renewal campaigns to past customers

- Organized, self-directed and dependable. We are not going to micromanage you

- Warm and human on the phone. Pushy salespeople do not last here

- Reliable internet, a working headset, and a quiet place to take calls

- Able to work US Central Time business hours



NICE TO HAVE

- Background in home services, construction, or any trades or field-service business

- Experience with
 and SMS campaign tools

THE DETAILS

 us. All applications and messaging go through OnlineJobs.ph.

It is not required, but the candidates who do it get looked at first. It tells us you want to work for this company specifically, not just any company.

description:
Restaurant Sales Development Representative

Research, Cold Calling & Lead Qualification

REMOTE  •  PART-TIME CONTRACT  •  APPROX. 20 HOURS/WEEK



About FetchMe

FetchMe helps independent restaurants grow direct revenue through modern websites, online ordering, catering, delivery, and restaurant technology. We help restaurants strengthen their brand, own their customer relationships, and reduce unnecessary dependence on third-party marketplaces.



Position Summary

FetchMe is hiring a part-time Restaurant Sales Development Representative to identify, contact, and qualify independent restaurants in selected U.S. markets. This is not a data-entry-only research position. The role requires speaking directly with restaurant owners, general managers, and other decision-makers by phone.

You will research prospective restaurants, make outbound calls, understand how each restaurant currently handles its website, online ordering, catering, and delivery, identify business needs, and create qualified opportunities for the FetchMe sales team. You are not responsible for closing the sale; you are responsible for determining whether the restaurant is worth the sales team's time and securing the right next step.

Success is not a bigger spreadsheet. Success is a legitimate restaurant opportunity created through accurate research and a real conversation.



Core Responsibilities

Research and Prepare

- Identify independent restaurants that match FetchMe's target customer profile.

- Research ownership, location count, website, online ordering, catering, delivery, and technology setup.

- Identify and verify the owner, general manager, operator, or other relevant decision-maker.

- Document the reason each restaurant may be a good fit before outreach begins.



Call and Engage

- Make outbound calls during appropriate U.S. restaurant business hours.

- Professionally navigate restaurant staff and gatekeepers.

- Explain the purpose of the call clearly without sounding scripted or aggressive.

- Ask thoughtful questions, listen carefully, and follow up consistently by phone or
.



Qualify and Advance

- Understand the restaurant's current website, online ordering, POS, catering, phone ordering, delivery, and third-party marketplace setup.

- Identify real needs such as an outdated website, no direct ordering, high third-party dependence, missed phone orders, weak catering tools, unreliable delivery, or limited customer data.

- Determine whether the restaurant is a qualified FetchMe opportunity.

Schedule a meeting or establish a clear, credible next step with the decision-maker.



Document and Improve

- Record every call, conversation, objection, qualification insight, next action, and next-action date in the assigned tracker or CRM.

- Provide concise notes that allow a salesperson to continue the conversation intelligently.

- Report recurring objections, competitor information, customer needs, and market feedback.

- Never fabricate contact information, conversations, or qualification details.



What Counts as a Qualified Opportunity

A restaurant should not be handed to sales as qualified unless all of the following are true:

- The restaurant matches FetchMe's target customer profile.

- The owner or relevant decision-maker has been identified.

- The current website, ordering, catering, or delivery setup has been reasonably confirmed.

- A legitimate business need or growth opportunity has been identified.

- The restaurant has agreed to a next step, or there is a credible path to engaging the decision-maker.

- Complete and accurate notes have been entered into the tracker or CRM.

A restaurant name and
 address alone are not a qualified opportunity.



Qualifications

REQUIRED

- Prior cold-calling, appointment-setting, SDR, telemarketing, lead-qualification, or outbound-sales experience.

- Strong spoken and written English with a clear, professional phone presence.

- Comfort speaking with U.S.-based small-business owners and managers.

- Ability to ask follow-up questions and hold a natural business conversation.

- Strong listening, note-taking, organization, and follow-up discipline.

- Experience researching decision-makers and business contact information.

- Reliable internet connection and a professional calling environment.

- Ability to work agreed U.S. Eastern or Central business hours.



Preferred

- Restaurant, hospitality, foodservice, POS, payments, delivery, or restaurant-technology experience.

- Experience calling independent restaurants or owner-operated businesses.

- Experience using a CRM or structured sales tracker.

- Experience booking qualified meetings for a sales team.

- Familiarity with tools such as Google Maps, LinkedIn, Apollo, Hunter, Toast, Clover, Square, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, or ezCater.



Hours and Compensation

- Approximately 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday.

- Schedule must include consistent overlap with U.S. Eastern or Central business hours.

- Most calls will be placed outside peak lunch and dinner periods; preferred windows are generally 10:00-11:30 a.m. and 2:00-4:30 p.m. in the restaurant's local time.

- $5-$7 USD per hour, based on relevant experience and demonstrated phone ability.

- Potential performance incentives may be tied to qualified meetings that are completed, opportunities accepted by sales, and CRM accuracy.



Performance Expectations

- Benchmarks will be calibrated during the first 30 days. Performance will be evaluated on quality and business impact, including:

- Accuracy and quality of restaurant research

- Outbound call activity and meaningful conversations

- Verified decision-makers and qualified opportunities

- Meetings scheduled and completed

- Quality and completeness of CRM notes

- Follow-up discipline, judgment, and coachability



Mandatory Two-Stage Selection Process

Stage 1: Recorded Role-Play and Qualification Test

Stage 1 is part of the application process itself. As part of applying, all candidates will complete a recorded, approximately 20-minute video role-play that includes a simulated call with a busy restaurant manager. Candidates should record the roleplay with a colleague, who will play the role of the restaurant manager, and then submit the video along with their application materials.

In the recording, the candidate must explain the reason for the call, navigate a gatekeeper, ask discovery questions, respond naturally, handle an objection, determine whether the restaurant is qualified, secure an appropriate next step, and submit concise CRM notes immediately afterward.

Candidates who pass Stage 1 will be shortlisted and invited to move on to Stage 2: Paid Practical Trial.

Sample objection: “We already use Toast and DoorDash, and we are happy with them.”



Stage 2: Paid Practical Trial

The strongest candidates will complete a paid trial using 5-10 FetchMe-approved restaurant targets. The trial must be completed within a 48-72 hour window from the time targets are issued, and is compensated at a flat rate.

Candidates will research each restaurant, identify the likely decision-maker, make outbound calls, document each attempt and conversation, confirm the restaurant's current setup when possible, identify a legitimate business need, recommend the next step, and enter complete notes into the assigned tracker or CRM.



Scorecard (1-5 each): Phone presence | Listening | Discovery | Qualification | Notes and coachability

The final decision will be based on actual calling performance, qualification quality, documentation, and coachability – not just the resume, written application, or hourly rate.



How to Apply

Please provide the following:

Resume and hourly rate

Reliable weekly availability and specific U.S. business hours you can work

A brief description of your cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

Typical call volume and measurable results from a prior role

Examples of CRM, lead-qualification, or sales-development work, when available

Stage 1 roleplay video link and accompanying CRM notes

Please note that incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Make sure all items above are included before submitting.

title: Senior Backend and Integrations Engineer
description:
AI Scaling is hiring a Senior Backend and Integrations Engineer to build the reliable systems behind an operating platform for AI implementation agencies.



AI Scaling OS connects CRM, campaigns,
, calendars, meetings, documents, automations, and AI agents. The hard part is not calling individual APIs. It is keeping provider truth, database truth, user-visible state, and tenant boundaries aligned when events arrive late, repeat, fail, or disagree.



You will work primarily in TypeScript, Deno Edge Functions, Supabase, and Postgres. You will also work with OAuth, webhooks, scheduled reconciliation, external APIs, agent control planes, and production diagnostics. You do not need experience with every provider we use, but you must have built reliable integration-heavy systems before.



What you will own



• Design and maintain APIs, Edge Functions, database functions, migrations, and integration contracts.

• Build idempotent webhook ingestion, reconciliation jobs, retry paths, and failure-safe provider actions.

• Preserve strict org-level tenant isolation across data, credentials, and provider operations.

• Improve observability so operators can distinguish source state, database state, deployment state, and provider state.

• Work with Postgres constraints, indexes, transactions, row-level security, and data migrations.

• Integrate systems such as
, calendars, CRM, enrichment, communications, meeting intelligence, and AI runtimes.

• Write automated tests for authentication, authorization, idempotency, concurrency, and negative paths.

• Review existing boundaries before adding new services or duplicating control planes.

• Participate in incident diagnosis and verify fixes against live behavior.



You may be a strong fit if



• You have at least five years of professional backend or platform-engineering experience.

• You are highly proficient in TypeScript and SQL and can work effectively in Deno or Node environments.

• You have built production integrations involving OAuth, webhooks, queues, scheduled jobs, or eventual consistency.

• You understand multi-tenant authorization, secret handling, API security, and safe migration practices.

• You can design idempotency and reconciliation instead of assuming external systems are always available or consistent.

• You write focused tests and can reason about failure, rollback, retries, and concurrency.

• You communicate clearly in written English and document decisions another engineer can operate.

• You can show examples of backend systems or integrations you personally built.



Helpful experience includes Supabase, Postgres row-level security, Deno Edge Functions, Fly.io, OpenAI or agent systems, Twilio, Google Workspace APIs, Instantly, Apollo, or other integration-heavy SaaS products.



Structure



• Full-time remote contractor

• Remote worldwide

• At least four working hours of weekday overlap with U.S. Eastern Time

• $7,000 to $10,000 USD per month, based on experience

• Reports into AI Scaling product and operations leadership



Application process



Submit a resume or LinkedIn profile, relevant technical work, and a concise description of one integration or backend system you personally owned. Strong candidates will complete a structured technical conversation and a short paid work sample using a sanitized reliability problem. We do not expect applicants to know AI Scaling's internal conventions before training.

This is a direct-hire role. No BPO, no agencies, no micromanagement.



Working Hours (Non-Negotiable):

You must be able to work US Eastern Time hours.



Initial Period: During your training and onboarding, you must start your daily shift between 9:00 AM and 10:00 AM US Eastern.



Long-Term Flexibility: Once you are fully trained and have proven your competence, you will earn the flexibility to choose your own start time anywhere between 7:00 AM and 12:00 PM (Noon) US Eastern, depending on what works best for you..



What You Will Do (The "Player" - Hands-On NetSuite Execution):



Heavy Involvement in a Large Account: You will take a substantial role in managing the core daily accounting and the month-end close process in NetSuite for a large client.



Collaborative Workflow & Reporting: You will not be on an island. You will work under the direction of existing senior team members who currently support this account. As you get trained and take over the regular workflow, you will continue to report directly to those team members, as well as to the CEO.



What You Will Do (The "Coach & Fixer" - QBO & Team Leadership):



Hands-On QBO & Cross-Platform Work: Act as a lead accountant for a portfolio of US-based clients running on QuickBooks Online (QBO) and other platforms. If a junior team member makes a mistake or falls behind, you must be fully capable and willing to jump into the software and do the work correctly yourself.



Workflow Prep & Data Entry: You must be comfortable rolling up your sleeves for foundational tasks. This includes manually loading bank transactions from PDF statements, prepping jobs/tasks for team members, and chasing down missing receipts.

title: Jr SEO Specialist (WordPress + Reporting),  US Agency

About us

Chase blog approvals with our team when they have been sitting too long, and tell us about a blocker the day you hit it.

Maintain Google Business Profiles, citations, and review responses for your accounts.

Run a weekly snapshot of blogs written vs approved vs published.

You have 1 to 2 years of hands-on SEO work, or you're a very careful junior who can prove it in our paid trial.

You can take a Google Doc and turn it into a clean, live WordPress post without help. Elementor experience is a plus.

You can open Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 and tell us what you see.

Your written English is clear.

You're the kind of person who catches the small mistake everyone else scrolls past. Be honest with yourself on that one, because it is most of what this job actually is.

You are not a fit if



You run an agency or a team and want to place this job with them. We're hiring one person who works inside our team.

You want part-time or project work. This one is full-time and long-term.

Pay and terms



$900 to $1,200 USD per month based on experience, paid reliably and on schedule. The role is long-term, and our SEO division is expanding, so there is room to move up inside it. We hire globally and pay in USD.



How to apply

The form asks for a code word. It is MAGNOLIA. Applications without it are not reviewed.



Shortlisted candidates do a short video screen, then a paid trial task on live work at the same rate the job pays: publish 2 posts to our staging site and QA one report. We will tell you up front that the report has errors planted in it. Find them.

title: Character Illustrator-Animator | AI Visual Producer
description:
Prismiera is building an identity-forward jewelry/e-com brand through animated AI series' and worldbuilding. We're hiring a remote creative-production specialist for character design, animation, and charm.



We're looking for someone who can draw by hand as a baseline indicator for art fundamentals; whose work shows strong character taste — expression, gesture, emotional acting, aesthetic charm, and animation or storytelling instincts. AI tool experience is a plus, not a requirement. We can train the AI pipeline relatively quickly, but the artistic talent and execution ceiling we're looking for is not something we can teach. Therefore,



**We're especially interested in people who've built and sustained their own creative work — a channel, a webcomic, indie projects, a personal art practice, or deployed content for someone else with sustained self-directed shipping and creative exploration and ownership. If your background is more traditional (studio, agency, client work), that's fine too — we'll evaluate on the work itself.**



AI has collapsed the creative space into taste, artistic eye, experimentation, and speed of execution. So we're looking for execution discipline — you finish work, you iterate cleanly, you ship completed videos autonomously under shifting artistic demand, and you adapt quickly across different styles and mediums.



What you'll do



Steering, selecting, rejecting, refining, and sequencing AI-generated visuals so they match our shifting style demands, emotional tone, and character identity.



- Visual-audio judgment and strict curation of AI output

- Refine expressive character stills using AI tools, reference pools

- Generate motion video from curated stills using AI video tools (Seedance2, Kling — guidance provided)

- Time clips of varying styles to narration, and deliver finished 20–60 second character-led videos

- Curate ElevenLabs voiceover and attitude (guidance provided)

- Sequence and time motion clips against narration

- Keep recurring characters consistent across many pieces

- Help build reference systems and visual judgment language over time

- Document what worked, what failed, and why — so the system improves



Style direction

Character work with high emotional expressiveness — diverse emotional and stylistic grammar from shoujo/josei to shonen/seinen to other virality-native illustrated character storytelling styles. Work should feel alive and artist-directed, not randomly generated (your art has an opinionated, taste driven direction, not general). You can play across emotional registers — dramatic, comedic, melancholic, playful, action-driven.



We provide SOPs on content format and scripting, but having your own working sense of what makes content land + general virality sense, will make the process smoother.



You might be a fit if you

- Have visual substrate in character work — illustration, comics, animation, storyboards, VTuber assets, visual novels, AI character work, or another medium where expression and character consistency matter

- Can diagnose why a character feels off

- Sustain self-directed creative output

- Are curious about AI image and motion tools, even if you haven't used them extensively yet

- Can time visual beats to narration rhythm

- Communicate clearly and work well async



AI-assisted portfolios are welcome — we'll evaluate your execution.



Compensation

$800–$1,100 USD/month full-time depending on portfolio and trial performance. Higher long-term compensation available for candidates with autonomous judgment as we expand our worldbuilding and brand. We're looking for a long-term creative partner.



Trial period prior to confirmed engagement. Tool access and AI tool credits provided.



How to apply

Send:



Portfolio link — your best work. Ideally work you've deployed into your own channels or someone else's, or any creative project you've sustained over time, showcasing self-directed creative ownership.



Character or emotional pieces, showcasing your expressive range, charming aesthetic execution, etc.

Motion or sequence sample if available (animatic, short edit, Live2D/VTuber motion, AI motion, storyboard sequence, AE edits, etc)



Use at least 7 apply points.

title: VIDEO EDITOR WANTED, LONG-TERM, $500/MONTH
description:
We run a large short-form content operation, our clips pull millions of views across a big network of accounts, and we're adding editors to the team. Long-term position with steady work every single week.



The work: Editing recorded OmeTV sessions into short viral clips. You watch the footage, find the moments worth clipping, and cut them into clean vertical clips with sound effects, captions and good pacing. You're not hunting for perfect moments, normal ones work fine, we just skip the boring small talk. What matters is that a stranger watching can follow what's going on. We provide all the footage, there's always more than you can finish.



The pay, two options, you choose:



1. Standard. Steady hours, fixed pay. You work the set schedule, hit the daily numbers, and get the same $500 every month. Nothing to calculate and no surprises. If the footage is thin one day you still get paid the same.



2. Per clip. You get paid for every clip you deliver. Hit the same daily numbers and you land on the same $500, but there's no ceiling on it. An extra hour or two a day puts you around $600, and the ones who really push go past that. Plus $10 on top for every clip that passes 1M views.



Both are paid on the 1st and 15th, always on time. No hourly rate and no time tracker either way.



Requirements: Full-time, around 8 hours a day, 6 days a week. Fast stable internet and a PC that handles editing smoothly. Short-form editing experience, CapCut is enough.



Every clip goes through review and only approved clips are paid, we approve everything as long as the quality is there. We choose few people and keep the ones who deliver.

title: SYSTEMS, AI & OPERATIONS LEAD for Multi Brand Event Planning Company
description:
WHO WE ARE

We’re a family of event and hospitality brands built on the same core idea: no detail is too small to matter. Cause We Can Events has crafted high-touch, multi-day wedding experiences since 2012 with 200+ weddings, preferred vendor status nationwide, and features in publications like Green Wedding Shoes and Rocky Mountain Bride. The Creek Dinners and our soon-to-launch UNBRIDLD Events extend that same standard into new formats. Three brands, one operating standard: things run right because someone built the system that makes sure they do.



THE ROLE AT A GLANCE

Position: Systems & Operations Lead Reports To: Gabby Pinkerton, Founder

Type: Part-Time W2 Employee Rate: $24–$28/hour, based on experience Location: Remote. Brands Supported: Cause We Can Events, The Creek Dinners, UNBRIDLD Events

Client-Facing: No. This is a behind-the-scenes role

Target Start: August 2026



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Growing three brands at once means details live in a dozen different places. This role exists to get all of it into one system that actually works, and to build the automations that mean it doesn’t all have to be done by hand every single time. We want consistency with the brands and being proactive instead of reactive.



WHAT YOU’LL OWN

You are the operational backbone across all three brands. You build the systems, wire up the automations, and keep the logistics running behind the scenes.



You will:



Build and maintain operational systems in Notion, Google and other platforms across all three brands

Design and implement automations (Notion, AI tools, Make, or similar) to cut down manual, repetitive work

Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting, and day-to-day operational tasks

Handle vendor communication, timelines, and event-day logistics details (fully behind the scenes, never client-facing)

Write marketing
s and build out a marketing content calendar, working directly with Gabby

Document how things get done: SOPs, templates, and checklists that make every process repeatable

Build your own systems and templates

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

Strong Notion skills: comfortable building databases, templates, and workflows

Genuine interest in automation and AI tools: you enjoy figuring out how to make a process take five minutes instead of fifty

Comfortable owning logistics and vendor communication with precision and follow-through

Event industry experience is a bonus

Self-directed: you’d rather build the right process once than be told what to do every time

OUR CORE VALUES

SYSTEMS OVER CHAOS If it happens more than once, it deserves a process. We build things so they don’t have to be rebuilt.

SWEAT THE DETAILS Precision is trust. Nothing falls through the cracks because we don’t let it.

CAN-DO ATTITUDE We figure it out. Problems are puzzles, not roadblocks. Curiosity beats complaints every single time.

BE THE CALM Events are high-pressure by nature. We are the steady, grounded presence behind the scenes for our team, our vendors, and each other.

HOSPITALITY FIRST Even behind the scenes, everything we build is in service of surprising and delighting the people in front of the client. Above and beyond is the baseline, not the bonus.

LOVE IS LOVE We celebrate every couple, every relationship, every love story. This is non-negotiable.

THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF…

You need to be reminded to follow through

You treat deadlines as suggestions

You’d rather wing it than document a process

You’re uncomfortable working independently

Details feel tedious instead of satisfying

You want a role where every task is handed to you fully defined — we want you noticing what’s missing and building the fix

You’re not interested in learning or using AI tools as part of your day-to-day

You don’t fully support and celebrate LGBTQ+ couples

This is non-negotiable. Please respect everyone’s time by not applying if any of the above is true.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH

$24–$28/hour to start, based on your experience level

Part-time W2 employee

Flexible hours, scoped around project and event deadlines

Weekly 1:1 check-in with Gabby

100% remote

Honored time-off requests

$25/month cell phone reimbursement

TRAINING & ONBOARDING

You’ll have access to a dedicated Loom training library before you start, including:



How to use our Notion systems across all three brands

Our complete operational workflow from booking through event day

Additional process videos as needed

Weekly check-ins with Gabby during your first months so you can ask questions and build confidence.

HOW TO APPLY

Send an
 to 
 with the subject line: “Systems & Operations Lead [Your Name]”



Tell us:



Who you are and your background

Why this role specifically speaks to you

One example of a system, process, or automation you built that made something meaningfully easier

Our process:



Step 1: Application review

Step 2: Initial video interview with Gabby

Step 3: Paid trial task

Step 4: Offer & onboarding



We can’t wait to meet you!
