title: Short-Form Video Editor (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)
description:
About the Role



We're a boutique branding studio based in the Netherlands. We work at the intersection of brand identity, strategy, and design execution, and everything we put out, including our short-form video, is expected to feel as considered as the brands we build.



We're looking for a skilled short-form video editor to join us on a gig basis, with a clear path toward part-time and eventually full-time collaboration for the right person. You'll receive a brief, brand deliverables, and a kick-off call, then own the edit from start to finish. Part of the work involves editing AI-generated footage (e.g. Kling, Runway) into finished, brand-grade reels, so comfort working with generated clips, and the imperfections that come with them, is essential.



This is not an entry-level role, and it is NOT for someone who just started editing and is looking to grow into the work. We need someone who has already done this at a high level, repeatedly, and can prove it with published work.



What You'll Do



- Receive project briefs via online meeting and written documentation, then independently own full short-form edits

- Cut vertical (9:16) reels for a range of brand contexts, including narrative pieces, product content, studio content, and more

- Design and animate captions and titles in the brand's typeface, kinetic typography that looks intentional rather than default auto-caption

- Handle sound design: choose and cut music, sync cuts to the beat, and time drops and hits so the edit lands emotionally

- Colour grade and unify footage from mixed sources, including AI-generated clips, into one cohesive look

- Work with AI-generated source clips: select the cleanest usable frames, cut around artefacts, and know when a clip needs regenerating

- Deliver organised, export-ready files to platform spec, and help us build reusable templates as the format matures



What This Role Is Not



This is not a role for a generalist or long-form editor. Wedding, vlog, corporate, and talking-head YouTube editing is a different craft, and we're specifically after short-form, brand-led vertical work.



It's not for CapCut-and-auto-captions editors. We care about custom, on-brand typography and real sound design, not templated defaults.



And it's not for someone who needs constant hand-holding. You receive the brief, ask the right questions upfront, and deliver, with proactive communication if questions come up.



What We're Looking For



Required:



- A strong portfolio of published short-form vertical work (Reels / TikTok / Shorts) that shows real craft. Brand or product content preferred, not personal vlogs. We will be looking at it critically

- Expert-level in either After Effects or Premiere Pro, and strong in the other. After Effects capability matters, because our caption and title work lives there

- Motion graphics and kinetic typography. You can animate text in a brand typeface and make it feel designed

- Genuine sound-design instinct. Cutting music to the beat and making a drop land is non-negotiable, it's where a good reel becomes a great one

- Colour grading, the ability to take mismatched clips and unify them into a single, cohesive look

- Comfortable editing AI-generated footage and working around its quirks

- Reliable communication in English, written and spoken

- Able to work independently from a brief with minimal back-and-forth



Nice to have:



- Hands-on experience with AI video tools (Kling, Runway, or similar)

- A templated, systematic way of working. You document your process, because we intend to make our best formats repeatable

- Familiarity with Figma and working from brand deliverables

- Prior agency or brand content experience



How We Work Together



Every project starts with a briefing call where we walk you through the use case, goals, and brand direction. After the call, we provide written documentation and all relevant brand deliverables. From there, you own the edit. We expect proactive communication if questions come up. No silence until delivery.



Compensation



This starts as a gig engagement, paid hourly, based on experience and portfolio. We pay well for the right person. Strong collaborators will have the opportunity to move into a structured part-time role, and eventually a full-time position as the relationship grows.



How to Apply



Send us:



- Your portfolio, links to published, live short-form work only. No unlisted mockups or screenshots of editor views. We want to see what you've actually shipped

- A short introduction: your background, the types of projects you've worked on, the tools you're expert in, and your hourly rate expectation



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid test project, one full reel edited from a real brief, before we move forward. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed.

title: Video Editor — Facebook Ads (E-commerce)
description:
We're a multi-brand e-commerce team looking for a video editor to own our
 ad creative long-term. English required.



What the job actually is



You'll edit ads that have to sell. Pacing, cuts, sound, timing, and hook construction are the tools that carry the message and make someone feel something in the first 3 seconds. If your idea of the work is chopping clips to a brief and clocking out, this won't work for you — we've tried it and it didn't last.



You're a fit if you:

What you get:

Performance bonuses

title: Creative Strategist | Performance Ads
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Creative Strategist who understands how to build ad concepts that are actually designed to convert.

A big plus if you have experience working in the trading, investing, finance, or algorithmic trading niche.

This is not a role for someone who simply puts a prompt into ChatGPT and sends whatever comes out.

We use AI in our workflow, but we need someone who can think independently, research angles, understand customer psychology, write strong copy, and come up with original creative briefs on their own. AI should enhance your thinking, not replace it.

What you’ll be doing:

• Researching competitors, audiences, offers, and winning ads

• Developing new hooks, angles, concepts, and creative strategies

• Writing strong direct response ad copy

• Creating detailed static and video ad briefs for designers and editors

• Breaking down winning ads and understanding why they work

• Coming up with new iterations based on performance data

• Working closely with the creative team to continuously produce new tests

What we’re looking for:

• Proven experience as a Creative Strategist or Direct Response Copywriter

• Strong copywriting and ad copy skills

• Strong understanding of Meta/Facebook advertising creatives

• Able to think creatively without relying completely on AI

• Understands hooks, awareness levels, pain points, objections, desires, and customer psychology

• Can turn research into clear, executable creative briefs

• Comfortable studying competitors and finding new angles

• Organized, reliable, and able to work independently

BIG PLUS:

Experience with trading, investing, finance, fintech, algorithmic trading, or similar niches.

When applying, please send:

A short introduction about your experience

Your portfolio or examples of creative briefs/ad copy

Brands or niches you’ve worked with

Your experience with trading or finance offers, if any

Your expected monthly rate

Please do not apply if your entire creative process is simply generating briefs with AI. We are looking for someone who can actually think like a strategist.

title: Experienced Amazon SEO Specialist / Affiliate Outreach
description:

title: Client Care and Inside Sales Coordinator: $6 Per Hour + Benefits and Performance Incentives
description:
Long Term Growth Opportunity to Become Office Manager



Job Description



Important: Cover Letter, Résumé, and Voice Recording Required to Apply



Attention to detail is essential for this position. To be considered, you must submit every item requested in the application section at the bottom of this job post.



Please review your application carefully and test all files and links before submitting. Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Do you love providing excellent service in a support based role?



Do you thrive in a fast paced environment, managing a variety of tasks? Do you love talking to customers and providing excellent customer service? Keep reading!



About Boulder Pro Painters



Boulder Pro Painters is a growing residential and commercial painting company serving Boulder, Colorado. We are committed to becoming one of the most trusted and highly reviewed painting companies in our area by providing excellent craftsmanship and an amazing customer experience.



We are a very entrepreneurial company, and we believe strongly in taking care of our customers and taking care of our amazing team members by providing a great work environment and career growth opportunities.



We value integrity, responsibility, and life balance. We believe work should empower your life, not take away from it. You should love where you work, be treated well, be part of a great team, and have opportunities to grow in your career.



Our growth and success depend on the culture we are creating. Our team is made up of ambitious and dependable people who are committed to personal growth, professional development, and producing great results.



In this role, you will work directly with me, the Founder and CEO of Boulder Pro Painters. You will help me manage customer communication, lead qualification, scheduling, follow up, marketing support, and the daily organization of the business.



This is an important, long term role with the opportunity to learn the business, take ownership of your responsibilities, increase your hours, and grow into our Office Manager as the company continues to grow.



Your Role and What You’ll Be Doing



We’re committed to creating an extraordinary company that provides excellent customer service for our customers. We want our customers talking about what an amazing experience they had working with Boulder Pro Painters. We want customers for life.



This role is a large part of that. Here are a few things you’ll be doing regularly:



* Answering the company phone line. In this business, it’s important that when customers call, someone answers or responds promptly.



* Making initial calls to customers who have requested an estimate.



* Asking qualification questions to understand the customer’s goals, project, location, timeline, and expectations.



* Following up with customers who have requested an estimate and setting appointments for me to meet with them and provide estimates.



* Managing estimate appointments in my calendar.



* Confirming appointments and handling cancellations and rescheduling requests.



* Following up with leads who have not responded or scheduled an appointment.



* Following up with customers who received an estimate but have not made a decision.



* Managing our social media pages and posting daily. This includes posting on our
 and Instagram pages and maintaining our Google Business Profile.



* Managing some of our online marketing channels by responding promptly and professionally to potential customers.



* Responding to customer comments, messages, and inquiries received through our social media and online platforms.



* Updating our CRM and lead tracker with accurate customer information, notes, appointments, and follow up activities.



* Keeping my calendar and daily priorities organized.



* Sending appointment confirmations, reminders, and routine customer communications.



* Supporting me with administrative responsibilities and the daily organization of the business.



As you learn our processes and demonstrate your ability, you will take on additional responsibilities, including:



* Reconnecting with old leads who may still need painting services.



* Reconnecting with past customers about future projects.



* Requesting customer reviews and referrals.



* Reaching out to property managers, real estate agents, designers, and other potential referral partners.



* Supporting customers after their project is approved.



* Sending routine project updates and helping customers understand the next steps.



* Tracking outstanding customer decisions, colors, scheduling details, and project information.



* Helping improve our call scripts, communication processes, and internal systems.



* Preparing simple lead, estimate, appointment, and follow up reports.



* Helping organize customer information, company files, and routine administrative records.



* Taking ownership of additional office management responsibilities as the company grows.



 Who We Are Looking For: About You



* You thrive in a fast paced work environment.



* You love being in a support role, and you love making other people’s lives easier.



* You enjoy talking with customers, and you get satisfaction from providing customers with an amazing experience each and every time you interact with them.



* You are a natural communicator, and you’re very comfortable talking on the phone.



* You speak and write excellent English and can communicate naturally and confidently with customers in the United States.



* People say you have great energy. You’re a positive, optimistic person.



* You’re a go getter. You don’t need to be told what to do at every step.



* You are proactive and always looking for what else you can provide to the business and the team.



* You are highly organized and pay close attention to details.



* You follow through on your commitments without needing repeated reminders.



* You take ownership when something needs to be completed.



* You can follow an established process while still having a natural conversation.



* You are comfortable asking qualification questions and discussing project expectations.



* You can manage multiple conversations, appointments, follow ups, and responsibilities without losing track of important details.



* You can move between phone calls, scheduling, customer communication, CRM updates, and marketing support while maintaining accuracy.



* You are comfortable receiving feedback, practicing calls, and continuously improving.



* You want a stable, long term position where you can grow with the company.



* You are available to transition into a full time overnight schedule as your training and responsibilities increase.



* You have reliable high speed internet, a dependable computer, a professional headset, and a quiet workspace.



* You have a dependable backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



Previous experience in inside sales, customer service, appointment setting, office administration, social media support, or supporting a United States based company is preferred.



Experience with a home service company, Google Workspace, GoHighLevel, CRM systems, scheduling software,
, Instagram, or Google Business Profile is helpful but not required.



We are willing to train the right person who has the right attitude, communication skills, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.



Compensation and Job Details



* This is a remote, long term position for candidates located in the Philippines.



* The position will begin with a paid 30 day introductory and training period of approximately 20 hours per week.



* Initial working hours will generally be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. Mountain Time.



* The current corresponding schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m.



* The position is intended to increase to 30 to 40 hours per week within approximately 30 to 60 days as training is completed, performance is demonstrated, and additional responsibilities are transferred.



* Candidates must have the availability and desire to transition to full time.



* Full time working hours will be Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Mountain Time, with a one hour unpaid meal break.



* The current corresponding full time schedule in the Philippines is approximately 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.



* Colorado observes daylight saving time, so the corresponding Philippine schedule will shift by one hour during the year.



* Your starting compensation is $6 USD per hour.



* You will receive an additional $5 USD for every qualified estimate you personally schedule that is completed.



* To qualify for the incentive, the appointment must meet our established service area, project type, customer, timeline, and investment guidelines. It must also be documented correctly in the CRM and attended by the homeowner.



* The incentive does not apply to canceled appointments, missed appointments, duplicate leads, disqualified projects, self scheduled appointments, or appointments scheduled by another team member.



* You’ll be paid twice per month.



* Paid training is included.



* Your performance and compensation will be formally reviewed after your first 90 days.



* Strong performers may receive an increase to $7 USD per hour after the 90 day review.



* You will receive prorated 13th month compensation based on your regular base pay and time worked during the calendar year.



* Paid time off will be available after successfully completing the first 90 days.



* Additional performance incentives, raises, and promotions are available to top performers.



* This position has the opportunity to grow into our Office Manager as Boulder Pro Painters continues to grow.



This is more than a short term virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, understand how the company operates, and take on greater responsibility over time.



Our business is growing, and we’re looking to hire someone within the next two to four weeks as soon as we find the right fit.



Does this job sound like a good fit for you? Do you sound like the kind of person we are looking for?



We’d love to hear from you.



To Apply, Please Submit All Eight Items



1. A cover letter explaining why you are interested in this position and why you believe you are the person we are looking for.



2. Your current résumé.



3. A one to two minute voice recording introducing yourself and describing your customer service, inside sales, office administration, or social media experience.



4. Confirmation that you can work the initial part time schedule and transition into the required full time Mountain Time schedule.



5. Your availability in both Philippine Time and Mountain Time.



6. A description of your internet connection and backup plan for power or internet interruptions.



7. Confirmation of whether you are currently working for any other clients or employers. If yes, include your current working schedule.



8. Your brief answer to this question:



A homeowner requested an estimate but did not answer your first call. What would you do next?



Before submitting, confirm that all files and links work and that anyone with the link can access them.



Incomplete applications will not be eligible for the second round. Due to the number of applications, we will not contact candidates to request missing information.



Best,



Jonathan Ramirez

Founder & CEO

Boulder Pro Painters

title: Team Leader / Executive Assistant
description:
Team Leader / Executive Assistant



I run a Content Marketing Company and I'm looking for someone to take real ownership of operations - not just execute tasks, but think ahead, spot opportunities, and help me run the business better.



Responsibilities:



-Manage and direct 7+ contractors — keep them accountable, coach them toward better performance, and lead them like a real team, not just a task list



-Bring ideas, not just updates — if you see a better way to do something, I want to hear it



-Make day-to-day operational decisions independently (e.g., approving routine expenses under $X, adjusting schedules, handling standard client requests) without waiting on me



-Know when something needs to be escalated - and bring it fast, with a recommended action attached



-Spot problems and opportunities before they become urgent, and act on them proactively



-Send regular, clear updates so I always know where things stand



What sets the right person apart:



*Thinks strategically - understands why a task matters, not just how to complete it



*Can mentor and coach contractors, balancing being approachable with holding a high bar - understanding, but not a pushover



*Comfortable making judgment calls and owning the outcome



*Social media / marketing background a strong plus



Requirements:



Direct hire/contractor only — no subcontracting the role out



2+ years managing teams or contractors



Strong written and verbal communication



Track record of initiative - has run something with real autonomy before



To apply:

Send your resume plus a short answer (2–3 sentences) to this: "Tell me about a time you noticed a problem before anyone asked you to fix it, and what you did about it.



" Include the subject line "I'm your Best Partner" so I know you read the full post.

title: Customer Service Representative – E-Commerce
description:
# Customer Service Representative – E-Commerce



## About the Role



We are a fast-growing e-commerce company looking for a **Customer Service Representative** to join our team and take ownership of day-to-day customer support across our brands.



Your main responsibility will be simple: **make sure every customer receives fast, professional, and helpful support while protecting the customer experience and the business.**



You’ll handle customer questions, order issues, refunds, replacements, shipping concerns, product questions, and general support across
 and other customer service channels.



We’re looking for someone who is reliable, communicates exceptionally well in English, learns quickly, and can solve problems without needing constant supervision.



## Key Responsibilities



* Respond to customer
s and support tickets quickly and professionally

* Answer questions about products, orders, shipping, returns, and refunds

* Track customer orders and investigate delayed, lost, or incorrectly delivered packages

* Process refunds, replacements, cancellations, and order changes according to company policies

* Handle unhappy customers calmly and work toward positive resolutions

* Communicate with our fulfillment and operations teams when order issues need escalation

* Maintain accurate notes and records of customer interactions

* Identify recurring customer complaints or product issues and report them to management

* Follow existing customer service SOPs while suggesting improvements where appropriate

* Help maintain strong response times and customer satisfaction

* Escalate chargeback risks, unusual refund requests, or serious complaints appropriately

* Learn our products thoroughly so you can confidently answer customer questions

* Support multiple e-commerce brands as required



## What We're Looking For



**Required:**



* Excellent written and spoken English

* Strong communication skills

* High attention to detail

* Reliable and organized

* Comfortable working independently

* Strong problem-solving ability

* Ability to remain professional when dealing with frustrated customers

* Comfortable learning new software and systems

* Stable internet connection and reliable computer

* Available to work consistently during agreed working hours



**Preferred:**



* Previous customer service experience

* Previous experience working for a Shopify/DTC e-commerce brand

* Experience with Shopify

* Experience with customer support platforms such as Gorgias, Zendesk, Reamaze, or similar

* Experience handling refunds, replacements, cancellations, and shipping issues

* Experience working with international customers and fulfillment partners



## What Success Looks Like



You will be measured on:



* Response time

* Resolution time

* Customer satisfaction

* Quality and professionalism of responses

* Accuracy when processing refunds/replacements

* Ability to resolve issues without unnecessary escalation

* Attendance and reliability

* Ability to follow SOPs

* Ability to identify and report recurring problems



We don't want someone who simply sends templated responses. We want someone who **understands the customer's problem, thinks about the best solution, and takes ownership until the issue is resolved.**



## Ideal Candidate



You would be a great fit if you are:



**Customer-focused** — You genuinely want to solve the customer's problem.



**Calm under pressure** — An angry
 doesn't affect the quality of your response.



**Detail-oriented** — You notice order numbers, addresses, dates, tracking information, and small inconsistencies.



**Accountable** — If you make a mistake, you own it and fix it.



**Proactive** — If you notice the same problem happening repeatedly, you flag it instead of simply continuing to answer tickets.



**Efficient** — You understand that great customer service needs to be both high-quality and fast.



**Commercially aware** — You want to keep customers happy while also protecting the business from unnecessary refunds, abuse, and avoidable losses.



## Working With Us



You'll be joining an ambitious e-commerce team focused on building and scaling multiple consumer brands.



There is significant opportunity to grow with the company. A strong performer can take on additional responsibility over time, including **Senior Customer Service Representative, Customer Service Team Lead, or Customer Service Manager** responsibilities.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of the team rather than simply complete tickets for a few months.



## How to Apply



Please send us:



1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your previous customer service/e-commerce experience

3. Which customer service platforms you've used

4. Your experience with Shopify

5. Your current availability

6. Your expected monthly salary/rate

7. Your timezone

8. A short answer to the following:



**A customer
s saying their order shows as delivered, but they haven't received it. They are angry and demanding an immediate refund. How would you handle the situation?**



Please do not use AI to write your answer to the final question. We're more interested in seeing how you naturally communicate with customers than receiving a perfect answer.

title: D5 CGI/Renders - Photorealistic library
description:
Summary

# D5 Render Specialist Needed – Photorealistic Material Library



We are a UK architectural CGI studio looking for an experienced **D5 Render specialist** to create a reusable, photorealistic material library for residential projects.



Our main issue is **stonework and brickwork**, which currently looks flat, repetitive and unrealistic.



We need high-quality reusable materials for:



* Natural and reconstituted stone

* Brickwork

* Render

* Roof tiles and slate

* Timber cladding

* Paving and external surfaces



The materials must be correctly scaled, seamless and convincing at both close and wider camera angles.



Deliverables:



* Organised reusable D5 material library

* Editable texture maps and D5 files

* Materials tested on a SketchUp residential model

* Before-and-after renders

* Short video showing our team how to use them

* Commercial usage rights



Please apply with examples of your most **photorealistic residential renders**, particularly close-up stonework and masonry.



Start your application with **“D5 PHOTOREALISTIC”**.
